/47tshitrī sko/kunyajishedzi nizha la〈 tsunaji5 skyi~Xrngu sturto~Xjipyu / phywarwa 02༷tshi/༷sdu/ rdzuljusdukhrikhri s+dza/ sku0sa rngogo sa snrirdorde khyi6 sarngu ’spyo glukya rmā — ne 5 6 na ) 4tre4dan stsokhi 'ilja༅ji 6ched brjod/༈thode kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul chosags pas da lam 11da gangs can gyi dpa' wa'i khyu mchodag mkhas dbang blo bzang dbang phyug mchog gi gsung rtsom gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs kyis par skrun gnang bar legs brjod dang yi rang yod/dam pa de nyid ni/chung dus nas sangs rgyas kyi chos sgor zhugs te mdo rgyud rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam lhu/ma gsum gting tshugs pa gnang ste 'chad spel mdzad pas/bka' 'gyur bla ma zhes pa'i mtshan snyan rang byung du grags shing /dus 'gyur rjes rgya nag gis snga rjes 'dzin bzung btson 'jug thog 'jam rtsub kyi thabs sgodu mas sdug spyong sna mang btangatrong /snying stobs zhum med kyis thod kyi bden pa bden thogatu 'khyol thabs su the tshom dang bag tsha ci yang med par/rgya'i dbang 'dzin par gdong dang gdong gtugs kyi rtsod gling yig ngag gnyis thog nas mdzad thogabod kyi bstan srid gnyis kyi bla na med pa'i dbu 'khrid 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin bod kyi stod bcud rig gzhung dang bcas pa 'jig nyen gyi g.yang sa las skyob ched/rang gi lus srog longs spyod dang bcas pa dang bas blos btang mdzad pa'i dpa' bo mkhas mdzangs gnyis ldan zhig yin/de yang gang de'i gsung gsol 'debs byin rlabs sting 'jug las/rin chen khams brgya banasad pa'i zhing khams sprin//bskal brgyar phul kyang gzhal dka'i bka' drin cha//gsab phyir bka' bzhin bsgrub bya chos spyod bcur//dam bca' mi 'gyur ri mo snying la 'god//

tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod zhabs rdul dang / /mi 'bral gsung gi bdud rtsir longs spyod cing / /khyod gsung nyan cing sgo gsum bya ba kun/ /khyod mashes 'ba' zhig sgrub par byin gyis 〉mes/ /zhes 7tho nga sa mchogegi bka' dgongs rnams sgrub pa lhur bzhes mdzad rgyu'i g.yar dam bzhes pa ltar sku tshe hril wa ༄/da kyi bstan srid bde don gyi ched du gtong gnang mdzad yod/mkhas dbang gang des sdug sbyong mnar gcad kyi do dam 'ogatu'ang tshig nyung don zab kyi gsung rtsom ji rtsed cig mdzad khongs nas/ da lam 'dir 'khod bod kyi brda sprod kyi gzhung 'grel dang / shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo/ 7gong sa sku phreng rim byon spyi dang bye brag sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gi bka' drin dran zhing 'dod don gsol 'debs sogs kyi gsung rtsom khag bcu yod pa'i tshig don la gzhigs na/ dam pa gang de'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sku yon dang / zhum med kyi cing stobs/ g.yo med kyi dad dam/ lhad med kyi lhag bsam/ lhag par 'phags mchoge spyan rasagazigs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'idam pa'i rang rtagasagasal ler mngon pas/ gangs can pa'i sgobs pa dang mig rgyan dam par gzung 'os su mngon/dam pa gangade'i thugs bzhed bzang po rnams myur du 'grub pa'i can 'dunadang khong gi mdzad rjes dang legs bshad rnams la rang rigs rgan gzhon kun gyis mig dpe dang slob sbyong bya rgyu'i skul ma dang bcas/bod gzhung shes rig las khungs nas/ 11da rgyal 'o1 21zha1 phyi 'o1 2004 zla 8 tshes 19 la// //cidrung che g.yu ga karma dge be+egs/

dkar chagapar skrun gsal bshad/ dang pa/rtsom pa po ngo sprod/ bzhi pa/dang the// bod gangs can pa'i skad kyi sgra rig pa'i gtsug lag gi gzhung rtsa ba ྅/ma cu pa'i don rnam par bshad pa mkhas mchog bra ti'i zhal ༷/nga pad+ma dkar po zhes bya ba baXkyigs so// 1gnyis pa/ bod gangs can pa'i skad kyi sgra rig pa'i gzhung rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam bshad mkhas mchog bra ti'i zhal lung nga/da ma dkar po/ zhes bya ba bsdokyigs sdu/// 76ga༄/ma pa/ bod kyi sgra rig pa'i gtsug lag rgi gzhung / rtsa ba sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam bshad kyi mtha' dpyod rig pa'i zla zer zhes dran ba baX/ba/traṭa traṭa// 119bzhi pa/ brda spro da pa'i gtsus lagre rtsa ba sum cu pa dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i bsdus don lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// 189lnga pa/ yi ge ming tshig gi tshul ma do tsacuri bzong ru bhar byung ngang bcas pa risga/ lam sna nga byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// 39 (

drug pa/ shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo zhes bya ba'i sdom tshig 223bdun pa/ rang cag kha ba ri pa rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen 7gong sa 7skyabs mabo na chen po'i thugs rje bka' drin dran pa'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs 'dod don myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// 231brgyad pa/ lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog la bstodad cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa byin rlabs snying 'jug bkra shis char chen zhes bya ba bi dza ha re/ 235dgu pa/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po 7rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mchod mchog la bstodad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa skabs gsum bdag po'i rgyal rnga zhes bya ba bi dza ha re/ 242bcu pa/ 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po bcu bzhi pa mchodag gi gser zhal dgyes ston gyi gse la 'debs phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan zhes bya ba bsdokyigs sa// 250

par skrun gsal bshad/ dang po/par skrun gsal bshad/7spyi nor gong sa skyabs mabo na chen po mchog nas gsum bcu'i dus dran thengs 28 pa'i thog stsal ba'i bka' slob nang / de snga so so rang nyid kyi thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 'god dgos/ de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul sdug bsngal ji snyed rang thog myangs pa'i mi mang po zhig rim bzhin rdzogs 'gro yi yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i tshe de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig byung ba red ces sgom tshig tsam ma galta gas gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung 'i rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig thog la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgos zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshogs nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yod na yang las gzhi 'di'i thog dmigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/ rang yul bod nang du

bces rī / pa ra skrun sasal bayad/gzhi rtsa'i smra brdzod rang dbang tsam yang med na mi tshe'i lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam/ las yig thog 'bo da rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyid sdug mi 'dra ba brgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos myo/nga dngos byung gi lo rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi stad yig thog gsog skrub bgyis te rim/ bzhin 'di nas bod dbyin gnyis kyi thog par 'grems byed thub na/ lo rgyus kyi deb phreng kha thor du mi gnas par rjes rabs klog pa po rnams la 'tshol bde ba/ de bzhin mgon po gang nyid kyi dgongs gzhi rlab ṭa pri+o che sgrub thub pa ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsomyori sgrig par skrun gyi kha bskang thub pa sku gas la dmigs te 'di ga tshogs pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis las gzhi 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng brgyad pa bar par n+din bgyis zin pa dang /da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig yod khongs nas da res rgyal gces mkhas dbang blo bzang dbang phyug gi gsung rtsom phyogs sgrig ces pa 'di nas sku che'i 'o/ rgyus brgya cha gnyis tsam las zin med kyang dam pa gang de'i gsung rtsom kha 'thor du mi 'bo ba sogs dgos pa du mar dmigs te lo rgyus sbrags ma'i gsung rtsom phyogs sgrig 'di bzhin chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng dgu pa'i ming thog dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i thoge bod don rgyab skyor gnang mkhan rnams dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skyod ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan

par skrun gsal bshad/ gsurma pa /rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan gsos re/ lhag par ngo da phyi nang du gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams la bod kyi rig gzhung thad slob sbyong dang nyams zhib gnang rgyu dang /rgan rabs tshos bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs rig gzhung dang bcas pa'i ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtogs kyis mes ngotsware khrag rgyun ded nas bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/ mtha' don bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng dgu pa par du bskrun par rang gzhung bde srung las khungs nas ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba dang / shes rig las khungs nas ched brjod bka' drin stsal ba/ lhag par gsung rtsom rnams bod nas nyen 'gan du mar ma 'dzems par tshur gdan zhu byed mi/ de bzhin 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig pa dang las byed rnams nas deb gzugs su ma grub bar 'phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun thub par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul ce gas pa'i snu gas gtso rgya ma ye shes shodags ldan gyis ngo da rgyal lo 2131gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa/spyi lo 2004 zla 8 tshes 26 nyin/

rtsom pa po ngo sprod/ bzhi pa/rtsom pa po ngo sgrod/༈ gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas dbang rgyal gces dpa' bo slo bzang dbang phyug mchog ni nag chu rdzong khongs a masnga shog chung gi 'acadag pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu 1914 rab byung bce lnga pa'i shing stag zla 9 tshes 15nyin 'khrungs/ sku r+yāng ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bas bye mar phyag mdzub kyis yi ge sbyangs gnang ste phyag mdzub brdol ba'i 'o/ rgyus yod/ de rjes khul de'i gsang 'dus brag dkar dgon zhes par chos sgor zhugs te dgon de ga'i chos spyod slob gnyer khag la 'grus par mdzad/dge tshul slong gi sdom pa rim bzhin bzhes shing / thos sogs kyi 'jug pa yangs por phye phyir dbus khul du phebs te grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma dang / mkhas pa mang lngarware drung nas mdo rgyud gzhung lugs dang / zhar byung rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam phru ba gnyer rgya cher gnang ste mkhas btsun bzang po'i sku na tan mnga' ba zhig tu gyur/ brag dkar dbo na gyi dbu mdzad kyi mtshan bzhes nas bka' 'gyur ljags lung thengs 'ga' shas gnang bas khong la bka' 'gyur bla ma zhes snyan grags dbus khul du yang khyab/ spyi 'o/ 1959 lo bod du dus 'gyur skabs rgan slo bzang

lnga pa/ rtsom pa po ngo sprod/dbang phyug la mkhas pa'i snyan grags sku da pa dang / dgon pa'i las sner bsnyad btags bod byang phyo gas khul gyi gzhung zhabs dang / mi drag gang 'tshams dang mnyam du rgya mis 'dzin bzung gis nyes chad 'i 10 btang ste thog mar nag chu btson khang dang / de rjes 1963 lor grwa bzhi btson khang du btson 'jug byas/ nyes dus gtsang ba dang / 1970 lo nas ngal rtsol khongs zhwa mo yod pa'i las mi ru khag gsum pa dang / snye thang rdza phag bzo grwa bcas su ngal rtsol sgyur bkod du bzhag skabs der rgya dmar gyis sman rtsis dang / bod kyi skad yig lo rgyus sogs la gtor bshig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgyur bcos gang byung btang ba thugs kyis ma bzod par/ spyi lo 1978 lo mjug bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa'i sman rtsis khang gi shar ngos lam bzhi mdo /spar de snga rig gsar skabs yig chen tshags par sbyar 'grems byed sa'i ched bzos gyang ldebs kyi thog sbyar 'grems gnang ba'i gal che'i ched rtsom/ rig gzhung bsre bslad kyi rnyog ma drung ba'i nor bu ke ta ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhes pa de'i dum mtshams shig drang na/ der sngo da shog kha gang ma gnyis kyi thog yig phreng 83 sku da/ phyag bris kyi mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba zung tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang mtha' mar/ bcos gang bcos phyir dpyod la 'jug ces pa'i rjes su/ deng skabs tang krung dbyang gi thugs 'khur

rtsom pa po ngo sgod/ drug pa /zab bzhes 'og bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung nyams pa slar gso dang / mi nyams gong du spel phyir nye char sum rtags kyi 'grel chung zhig kyang par skrun 'grems spel gnang ba ni mchog tu dge zhing bkra shis pa'i sgo 'phar dbye bas bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor 'os pa nyid do// 'on kyang 'dir dpyad par bya ba'ang snang ste/ 'grel chung gi 'gor dpyad gzhi gnang na 'grig ces bkod 'dug nye 'char gsar du 'grems spel byung ba'i sum rtags kyi+o 'grel chung gi 'gor le+ogs sbyor skad kyi mtshan don dang / 'gyur phyag rtsam par dam bca' ba sags dar 'dug pa ma zad/ rtags 'jug gi 'grel cung la'ang yig nor dang / bsre bslad bcas btang 'dug pa na / sna/ga grangs mo mo moyig phreng ྾ ྾ ྾par/ kha cha tha tsha ga ja da// zhes par/ kha cha tha tsha ga ja dang // zhes yig nor dang / yang shog grangs ྾ ྾ ྾yig phreng mo ྾ ྾par/ bsgrub bya'i lha dang bsgrub par bya// zhes par/ bsgrub bya'i las dang bsgrub par bya// zhes dang / shog grangs moyig phreng mopa/ dper na lha ru gsal lta bu// zhes par dper na 'od du 'tsher/lta bu// zhes dang / shog grangs mo mo ྾yig phreng ྾ ྾ mopa/ dper na mchu zla shar ba na// cho 'phrul dus chen tshugs lta bu// zhes par/ dper na nyin byed shar ba na// sa steng smag rum mtha' ru bskrod// ces par bcos pa bcas byas 'dug rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan bcos

bdun pa/ rtsom pa po ngo sprod/gang zhig la'ang dbur legs sbyar gyi skad dod dang / 'gyur phyag sogs byed pa ni/ bstan bcos dam par bstan pa'i phyir// lha na pas thog mar dgos pa bstan// zhes byung ba bzhin bstan bcos khungs ma rnams kyi dbur rgya gar skad kyi thog 'gyur phyag dang / mtshan don bod skad du bsgrur ba sku gas ni chu 'bo gangs dang / chos 'go sangs rgyas la thug dgos pa bzhin dbur rgya gar skad du zhes ched du smos pa ni byin rlabs che zhing / bstan bcos 'di pa'i 'byung khungs rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas yin pa bstan pa'i phyir yin no/ /de med par bcos nas khyod kyi 'dod pa ltar na rgya nag skad du zhes pa zhig dgos kyi sku da kyang de 'o/ rgyus na ma grags pas bya thabs zad do/ /de bzhin bshad ma thag pa'i rig gzhung la bsre bslad btang ba ni rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dang mtshungs par dngos gtso smra ba yin khul gyis rnying bzhir brtsis nas gtor ba yin nam snyam yang / skar ma mchu ni rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi ya gyal te mkha' dbyings su khra lam mer gsal ba yod bzhin du dngos gtso smra ba khyod kyis khas len byed ma shes pa snying re rje/ mkhas nyams dpa' thal gyis ming tshig 'ga' zhig bcos khul byas kyang blun nyams mngon gsal dod pas ya nga ba'i gnas sku / /khyod kyi bsam par spyi lo 1959 'o/ra 7skyabs maspo na tā la'i bla ma mchog gis dbu 'khrid mdzad pa'i bod mi gnas yod kha cig rgya gar du phebs pa

rtsom pa po ngo spyod/ brgyad pa/dang / de byings bsad bzung shi gsum gyis rdzogs zin pa dang / lhag lus rnams kyi khrod nas bod kyi rig gzhung la shes rtogs med pas khyod tshos rdzun bzo gang byas yin snyam pa ni nor 'khrul red/ nga tsho bod mi ni sa zad rdo dang / lag zad dpung par thug med pa ma zad 'dzam gling mi mang nas bod 'dir spyan ce rer gzigs bzhin pas khyod gung khran tang gis gang byas yin snyam pa de ma yin par khyod kyis rnam pa kun tu bag sku/da par byedas shigaces dang / sbyar yig gi gsham du khong bzhugs yul snye thang rdza phag bzo grwa yin pa dang / phyag bris 'dra ya gcig rgya gzhung la gnang yod lugs mtshan dang bcas pa bkod gnang yod/spyi lo 1980 lor khong gi sman rtsis kyi mkhyen yon las rdza phag bzo grwa nas sman rtsis khang du gdan drangs/ skabs der sman gzhung ma dpe rnying pa rnams rgya dmar gyis rig gnas gsar brje zhes ming du btags pa'i nang gtor bcadam btang bas sman pa mkhas pa rnams kyis sman gzhung gsar bris gnang gi yod pa der dag bcos gnang dgos kyi yod/ sman gzhung gsar pa rnams kyi sngon sleng nang rgya dmar la bstun mkhas zol gyis phye gtor du ma byed dgos par thugs ma mnyes par/ 'go 'khrid la sman gzhung dang sngon gleng gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i gnas tshul 'di thog nas ngas zhu dag gtang thub pa mi 'dug gsar pa zhig bris zhes brjod na bris

dgu pa/ rtsom pa po ngo sgo da/chog ces gsungs pa sogs dang / skabs de'i snga rjes su bod don chodags pa zhig bas(gas gnang ba bcas kyis spyi lo 1981 zla 12 tshes 3nyin slar yang 'dzin bzung gis lo gsum dang zla ba drug ring grwa bzhir btson 'jug byas/ de'i ring khong gis nga bod kyi don du 'dzin bzung dang /khrims gakhyodad byas tsang / ngas bod kyi don du skad cha mang tsam mi zhu ka med yin zhes/ rgya dmar gyis bod btsan bzung byas lugs dang / bod nang 'phrog bcom dang / ngo da mi dmar gsod btang ba chodar skyin tshab gun gsab dgos lugs/ bod rgya mthun sgri ra rdo ring gi mna' yig snga na gsal bod rgya'i sa mtshams bskyar gso/ dgos pa/ gzhan yang bod rang btsan yin pa'i lo rgyus don tshan 16 'khod pa sogs cadad nge na gyod gtugs kyi yi ge rnam grangs bzhi bcu sa ra brtsams bris gnang ste bod rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i khrims khang gong 'og dang / las khungs khag ches mtho'i mi mang khrims khang bcas la sprad de ngo da don bden pa dag 'bud kyi rtsod kleng gnang / skabs der rgya mi'i las byed chos khong la bod rang btsan gyi 'dod tshul dor dgos pa'i slob gso thengs mang byed pa dang / skabs re drag rtsub rdung rdeg tshabs chen gtong ba/ skabs re 'jigs skul byed pa / skabs re mkhas snyan 'jam 'dul byed pa sogs thabs shes ji ltar spyad kyang / khong gis bod rang btsan dngos 'brel zhig yin pas ngas ro/ra

rtsom pa po ngo sprod/ bcu pa /mi thub/ bod rang btsan yin min nga tshar bgro kleng byas te brdar sha bcad na 'grigs/ de yang khyed rang tsho las byed pas thag mi chod pas/ yang na / nga tang gi 'go khrid tsho'i sar 'khrid/ yang na/ khong tsho nga'i sar 'khrid shog nga ོ ngo 'dzoms sar dngos yod gnas tshul sbyangs bshad byas na 'grigs zhes rang tshugs g.yo med brtan srung gnang / de'i tshe rgya dmar 'go 'khrid pas/ bod mi zhig gis bod don stodar la rtsod kleng byas pa 'di mi'i thodab thang du brtsi rgyu phar bzhag khrims 'gal nag nyes chen ngo ra brtsis te 1983 'o/ khong la rkang lcags lag lcags brgyab/ 'thab rtsod 'dri btsir lan mang byas mthar/ khyed kyis bod rang btsan yin zer ba/ kha bral gyi nag nyes che bas drag galha na bya rgyu yin zhes lha/ga thog gtang rgyu'i thag gcod byas/ skabs der bod phyi nang gnyis nas mkhas dbang blo bzang dbang phyug glod bkrol dgos pa'i skad 'bod shugs che byas pa'i nyer len gyis lam seng srog thog gtong bde ma byung bar/ 1984 lor khong la lo bco brgyad ring btson 'jug bya rgyu'i khrims thag bcad/ skabs der khong gis nga lo bdun cu don grangs nang 'chi rgyu yin yang gung khran tang gis nga'i mi tshe ring du btang bar thugs rje che zhes gsungs/ de rjes paṇa chen rin po ches bod nang bod yig dngos spyod byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang skabs bod yig dge rgan dkon pa'i babs dang bstun khong la btson

bcu gcig rtsom pa po ngo spu+od/khang nang bod yig dge rgan byed dgos bshad don ltar/ zla shas ring na gachodan kha cig la bod yig dang / lan lañdza/ wartu la sogs pa'i rig gnas slob khrid gnang ste phan 'bras gang che byung yang / slar yang / bod rang btsan yin zer mkhan dang / rtsa ba'i rtsa ro/na bzhi khas mi len mkhan/ bo nga bu gcig 'gyur kha bral gtong mkhan gyi log spyod pa zhig dge rgan byed mi chog ces dge rgan nas 'then te slar yang ngal rtsol du btang / skabs der sman rtsis khang la sman gzhung gi pu ti rnying pa 'dzing pa dang / cha mi tshang ba/ char chus rdung ba sogs kyi ma dpe du ma zhig lag son byung yod kyang bzo sgrig ma thub par grwa bzhi btson khang du khong la skyabs 'jug zhus te / snga phyir pu ti nyi shu tsam bskyal ba snga dgong las ka'i bar gseng skabs bcos sgrig hur bskyed 'bad brtson gnang / rjes su spyan gyis mi gzigs kyang gang nyid kyis slob bur klog bcug nas gsan te bcos sgrig byed bcugade lta'i skabs phyag las la phebs dgos pa dang spyan dang sku gzugs kyi gnas stangs zhan pas cadab bu rnams kyis gla cha med pa'i ngal las 'di dag mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i re skul zhu skabs/ gang nyid nas ma dpe bcos sgrig gi las ka 'di glo bur brtags na rgya mir phan pa lta bu snang yang phugs nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung yin pas nga tshos 'bad brtson ma byas na sus byed ces ngal ba du mas cha tshang bar bcos sgrig gnang / yang thengs

rtsom pa po ngo grod/ bcu gnyis/shig lo gsar skabs btson khang gi slob grwa'i nag pang steng shis tshig cig bri dgos zhes las byed nas bshad don ltar khong gis 7gong sa mchog dang /bod/ ting zha'o phing bcas la bstod pa re bris pa 'go khrid kyis shes te dri rtsad byed skabs khong gis shis tshig byas na bod kyi sa cha'i bdag por byed dgos/ don dngos bod kyi sa'i bdag po 7gong sa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yin pa dang / deng sang ting zha'o phing gis bdag po rgyag gi yod pas de ltar bris pa yin zhes gsungs/dus rgyun rgya mis chab srid slob spyong la bskul skabs gdung rtse kha gtad kyis dgag pa shugs che gnang ba'i khar/ rnam kun na gachodan chorware bsam blo'i sne 'khrid byed mkhan red ces rgya mis khong dgra nag tu bzung nas dus rtag tu sdang zug sdug sbyong tshad brgal rgyun mthud btang ste sku gzugs gcong can phan med baX sa rjes/ drag chas nyen rtog sman khang du sman bcos bya rgyu'i zol gyis nyin shas nyar ba de'i skabs gang gi slob bu zhig thabs du mas bcar thub tsam byung skabs bshal skyug gi snyun gzhi bzhes yod pa dang phal cher mi ngo yang mi chod pa'i tshod la slebs tshod/ gang gi zhal slob der nga la dug 'phog 'dug ces gsungs pa de ni nga tshos dpyad zhib gnang dbo sa pa'i gnad cig yin/ mtha' mar nyen 'gan las g.yol ched ljags dbugs chad la nye skabs sku nye tshor rtsis sprod byas pa de ma thag

bcu gsum/ rtsom pa po ngo sgrod/zhal nas khrag chodad med skyug ste 1987 zla 11 tshes 4 nyin sku tshe'i 'du byed stongs/ khong la btson khang nang dgra bos sdang 'dzin sdug sbyong de lta bu btang ste lus sems mi bde ba'i gnas skabs de 'dra'i dus su yang / snyoms las su ma bzhugs par/ 7skyabs mgon twa la'i bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i smreng gsol khye'u pha 'bod kyi gdung dbyangs zhes pa skabs bzhi'i bdag nyid can brtsams gnang mdzad pa de bzhin rang gzhung phyi 'brel lhan khang dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang nas snga phyir 'grems spel zhus zin pa de dang / nga tsho'i lag tu son pa da lta'i sum rtags gnyis kyi rnam bshad mkhas mchog bra ti'i zhal lung pad+ma dkar po zhes pa sogs gsung rtsom khag bcu yod pa 'di dag dang / lag son ma byung ba'i gsung rtsom rnams dang sku tshe'i lo rgyus rgyas tsam zhig zhib rtsad zhus kyang bsod nams kyi bgo skal du thob sku(na ma byung ba ni shin tu phangs pa'i gnas lags/gong gsal gsung rtsom de dag tshang ma btson khang nang dang ngal rtsol sgyur bkod ra ba sogs rgya mis phyugs ltar bkol spyodad byed pa'i skabs su bris gnang ba zhig yin rkyen/ khong gis rang rgyal khab dang mi mang ched bcangs pa'i lhag bsam la gsung rtsom nang nas tshig gcig kyang 'dor mi phod pa'i tshad du yod na/ khong gi dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi snying stobs la slob sbyong dang / zab yangs mkhyen rgya'i gsung rtsom gyi ro bcud myangs nas mchog

rtsom pa po ngo sgrod/ bcu bzhi/gsum skyabs su bzung / las 'bras kyi blang wa ra tshul bzhin spyad nas rnyed dka'i rten bzang don ldan du mdzad pa dang / chabs cig khong gi 'phral yun bzhed dbo ngas lhun gyis 'grub pa'i thugs smon dang / khong mig dper bzung / khong gi rjes su 'brangs nas rgyal gces lhag bsam snying stobs gong 'thor spel te khong gi bzhed don gtso bo bod mir thodab thang yod nges kyi bod rang dbang skrub pa la tshang mas 'bad brtson lhod med mdzad skyong dang / gong gsal sku che'i 'o/ rgyus rang gzhung phyi 'brel lhan khang nas bton pa sa bon du bzung nas skabs de dang de'i 'brel yod mi snar dri gtugs byas te bkod pa dang / 'dir mthun 'gyur bcar 'dri dang len mdzad po dam pa gang de'i dngos slob rang gzhung shes rig las khungs kyi las byed lha sa ba ྅/ zhabs bkra shis mchog dang / gsol 'debs khag gi ma dpe mkho 'don gnang mkhan se ra ba ྅/ zhabs brag g.yab lam bzang sogs la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin//blo bzang bkra shis kyis cadad rgyal 'o/ 2131 gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa/ spyi lo 2004 zla 8 tshes 21 nyin/

dang pa/༄yo//bod gangs can pa'i skad kyi sgra rig pa'i gtsug lag gi gzhung rtsa ba sum cu pa'i don rnam sa sto do|05par bshad pa mkhosna mchag bra 'a zhalo lung pad+ma dkar pa zhas bya ba bzhugs sa//༈ོna mo ༵ dī ༵ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ dī/gas rje'i ga bar rdul//kun nas dkar brte dpal mnga'༄ gangs ri'i mgon//srid gsam dbang bsgyur bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi//zhabs byel bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod//rgya gar rgyal bstan 'od zer brgya pa'i dpal//bsil ljongs gsal ba'i dpal du spel ba'i slad//

2smra ba'i rgyal po smra mchog lo tsā'i tshul//gnas lnga rnam gzigs saṃ lho ṭa la 'dud//gang gi legs bshad zla med shing rta'i srol//zag med chos sgo rab 'byams 'dzin pa'i gzhi//tshogs gsum sgra don ma nor lung ston pa'i//khyad chos bzhi ldan gzhung bzang 'grel la 'jug/de yang bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung gis bsngags pa'i byang phyogs kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir 'phags mchog phyag na padro'i sgyu 'phrul chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku'i ring la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe bod la yi ge med pas bstan rtsa yi ge'i srol gsar du gtod pa'i slad du 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul thon mi saṃlho ṭa 'khor dang bcas pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du yi ge slob par brdzangs pa la/ khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta mang po bsten nas sgra tshad yi ge'i tshul la sbyangs pa phul du phyin nas/ 'phags yul gyi yi ge lnga bcu tham pa la dbri sdon gyi sgo nas bod kyi yi ge sum cu tham pa'i sgra gzugs su bsgyur te gtan la phab nas/ bod gangs can gyi rang skad khyad par ba'i thog nas brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po brgyad/'phags yul gyi sgra gzhung chen po rnams dang mthun par don 'gyur mdzad

3pa'i sngon med shing rta'i srol chen gtod pa'i gtsug lag gi ya gyal rtsa ba sum cu pa zhes grags pa 'di'i don nyung ngu'i tshig gis rnam par bshad pa 'di la gsum/ thog mar dge ba klad kyi don dang / bar du dge ba gzhung gi+o don/ tha mar dge ba mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan dan dang 'gyur phyag ga /dang po ni rgya gar skad du/ byu ka ra ṇa mū la tro shad nā ma/ bod skad du lung ston pa rtsa ba sum cu pa zhes bya ba/ zhes pa ste/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skad rigs chen po bzhi'i nang tshan legs sbyar gyi skad du smos pa byu ka ra ṇa sogs te/ de wa da gangs can gyi skad du bsgyur na/ byu ka ra ṇa ni/ lung ston pa'am brda sprod pa ste/ sgra'i mtshan nyid ming tshig yi ge'i rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas don lung ston pa'am brda sprod pas de skad ces bya'o/ /mū la rtsa ba dang / hro shad sum cu pa ste/ sgra'i mtshan nyid lung du ston par byed pa'i rtsa ba'am rgyur gyur pa'i yi ge sum cu po'i sbyor ba rgya cher ston pas na brjod bya'i lha nas btags pa'o/ /nā ma ni zhes bya ba ste ming de skad ces bya'o zhes pa'o/ /lung ston pa'i don ni sgra la rgyud kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa gnyis/ de re re la lung ston pa dang mi ston pa gnyis re dang / snyan mi snyan sogs kyi dbye ba brgyad dam bcu gcig sku da pa las 'dir zin pa'i sgra brjod bya'i don lung du ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'gyur phyag

4ni / smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ ngag gi rang bzhin shes bya'i ngo bo dang rnam pa ma lus pa ji lta ba bzhin du smra ba la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal 'ege zhes pa ste/ lo tsā ba gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'gyur 'dis lung rtogs spyi dang khyad par shes rab kyi bslab pa'i gzhi ston pa'i phyir shes rab kyi lha la 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i don du phyag mdzad pa'o//gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos kyi gzhung dngos bshad pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/mchod par brjod pa dang / brtsams par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro bstan pa'i phyir dkon mchog gsum la spyir phyag 'tshal ba/ bye brag tu shes rab kyi lha 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal ba/ dgos pa'i dbang gis sgra'i lha rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal ba/ drin gzo ba'i phyir dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /dang po ni/gang la sku1na tan mchog mnga' ba'i//dkon mdzadag de la phyag 'tshal lo//

5zhes pa ste/ gang zhig la yon tan gyi mchog don gnyis mthar phyin pa dang / 'gog lam gyi bden pa/ rig grol gyi sku na tan bcas mnga' ba'i daskadan mchodag de gsum la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste/ dkon mchog gi don yang /rgyud bla ma las/'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir//mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi//rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir//'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid//ces ga3/ngas pa ltar/ sems can bse da nams ma bsags pa la snang ba min pas 'byung ba dkon pa'i sku na tan dang / lnga bo'i rang bzhin dri ma dang bral ba'i yon tan/ rang gzhan gyi don phun tshogs sgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i yon tan/ 'aspo ba thams cad kyi bsam pa dge ba'i rgyu yin pas 'jig rten gyi rgyan du gyur pa'i yon tan/ daskadan mchodag gang du gnas pa'i 'jig rten de 'jig rten gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa'i sku na tan/ ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur med pa'i yon tan te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che khyad chos drug gis khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos dang mtshungs pa'i yon tan drug mnga' ba'i daskadan mchog de la mkhan pos bstan bcadas rtsom pa'i

6thog ma nyid du phyag mdzad pa ni/ de'i tshe bod du bon las med pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i srol gsar du gtod pa la dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum ni sems can rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs kyi mchog tu ston pa'i phyir yin pas dgos pa lhag par che zhing / dkon mchog de la'ang theg pa che chung gis dbye ba mang yang spyi'i lugs kyi dkon mchog dngos ni sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid dang / chos 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i lung dang rtogs pa/ dge 'dun theg pa gsum gyi slob pa lam zhugs 'phags pa'i chortags te/ de yang sangs rgyas ni skyabs ston pa po/ chos ni mthar thug gi skyabs dngos/ dge 'dun ni gnas skabs kyi skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs so/ /rjes mthun pa'i dkon mchog ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang / lung gi chos glegs bam/ dge 'dun so so'i skye bo bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs so cog ste/ de dag la mkhan pos phyag mdzad pa ni rjes 'jug gi skye wa theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa rnams kyis dkon mchog gi yon tan shes nas de la dad cing skyabs su 'gro ba'i lam de ni yang dag pa'o zhes 'doms pa'i don du yin no/ /'dir phyag 'tshal ba'i la don gyi rnam dbye ni bzhi pa'i sgra'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu shes rab kyi lha 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal ba ni/gang gis sgra dbyangs kun gsungs pa'i//

7'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'o///zhes pa ste/ gang gis sgra dbyangs brjod pa thams cad ston cing gsungs pa por mdo rgyud rnams las gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu dang ngo bo'i skyon gyis rtsub reg dang bral ba'i 'jam pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs mdzadag mnga' ba'i khyad par du gyur pa/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen rab gcig tu bsdus pa'i sngo bor gyur pa de la gus pas phyag 'tshal 'o// /zhes pa ste/ nges pa'i don du mkhan ngo nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas 'dir de nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste phyag mdzad pa'o/ /gsum pa dgos pa'i dbang gis sgra yi lha rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal ba ni/gang gis ming gzhi spyodan gsungs pa'i//rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal 'o///zhes pa ste/ gang gis 'jig rten na ming gzhi'i yi ge snge na du gsungs pa po rtag zhi ba ste dbang phyug chen po la phyag mdzad pa ste/ 'di ni bram ze rig byed smra ba'i gzhung du 'jig rten gyi byed po nyi shu rtsa bzhi las yi ge'i byed po lha dbang phyug chen por yin par bshad pa ltar/ rje nyid kyi slob dpon bram ze li bi ka ra mo gas kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par phyag mdzad pa'o/ /bzhi pa drin gzo ba'i phyir dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal ba ni/

8sdeb sbyor legs mdzad mkhas rnams dang //bla ma la yang phyag 'tshal nas//zhes pa ste/ sgra'i rgyu yi ge ming tshig gi don sdeb legs par sbyor ba'i 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa spyi dang / bye brag mkhan po rang nyid kyi bla ma lha rig pa'i seng ge dang bram ze li bi ka ra la sogs pa rnams la bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas phyag mdzad paso// / nas zhes pa mtshams sbyor gyi tshig phrad do/ /gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing //rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu//ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi//yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya//zhes pa ste/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad yi ge la ltos pas de dag kun gyi gzhi yi ges 'dzin par byed cing / phyi rol pa'i nges brjod dang / mchod sbyin/ snyan tshig srid srung ste rig byed bzhi sogs dang phyi nang thun mong gi bzo dang gso ba/ sgra dang tshad ma/ sdeb sbyor dang skar rtsis la sogs pa'i rig gnas thams cad yi ge kho na la ltos pas de dag gi rgyu yin pa dang kun gyi rgyur gyur pa'i yi ge sil bu du ma

9'dus pa las don gyi ngo phra tsam ston pa'i ming dang / ming 'dus pa las don gyi khyad par ྅ na pa'i tshig dang / tshig mang du 'dus pa las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ngag gi bsnyu da pa thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba yi ge yin pas/ 'phags yul gyi legs par sbyar ba dang mthun pa'i bod kyi brda yang dag par ston pa'i yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya'o zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar na yi ge'i sbyor ba nyid 'di'i brjod bya dang / yi ge'i sbyor ba shes pas gtsug lag gnyis kyi blang dor la mkhas pa ni dbo sa pa dang / blang wa ra gyi lbā nas ro/na nyams su blangs pas mthar thug rnam mkhyen thob pa ni nying dgos dang / gzhung tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa ni 'brel ba ste dgos sogs chos bzhi'ang ston pa yin lha / /gnyis pa sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos kyi gzhung dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ yi ge'i khyodar ba rgyas par bshad pa dang / gdams ngag brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ yi ge'i sbyor ba'i yi ge'i rnam gzhag dang / yi ge'i sbyor ba dalnga sa kyi ming tshig gi 'jug pa bstan pa'o/dang po la gnyis/ dbye ba'i sgo nas ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang / sdon rjes su 'jug pa dang mi 'jug pa'i khyad par bstan pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba dang yan lag gi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yi ge ā li kā li gnyis zhes pa ste/ gong du mtshan don gyi skabs su rtsa ba'i yi ge sum cu

10tham par bstan pa de nyid la dbye na ā li dang kā li gnyis su 'gyur te/ ā li ni a phreng ste dbyangs dang /tre kā li ni ka phreng ste gsal byed de/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba de gnyis su nges par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi dbye ba ni/6/ li gsal byed 6) sogs bzhi//kā li sum cu tham pa'o//zhes pa ste/ ā li'i bya ba gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge i u e o bzhi ste/ de dag gsal byed rnams la zhugs pa'i gi gu dang / zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ rna ru/ bzhi yin pa dper na/ ki ku ke ko lta bu'o/ /kā li'i bya ba gsal bar byed pa ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha a ste yi ge sum cu tham pa'o/ /de'ang yi ge la legs sbyar gyi skad du ak+ṣa ra ste 'gyur med dang / ñdza na ste gsal byed dang/ war+ṇa ste rjod byed ces bya zhing / de dag ni ngo bo dang / las dang / dgos ched kyi sgrar gsungs so/ /'dir bod skad sor bzhag la ring thung gi rnam gzhag med pas mkhan pos yi ge bsgyur ba'i skabs su/ rgya gar gyi dbyangs bcu drug gi nang nas ā yī skyu dzā dṛ '-i wī e o+o e aḥbacas bcu gcig bod skad la mi 'gyur bas bor zhing / dbyangs dang po a yig de cadad kyi yi ge gsal byed kyi tha mar bsnan

11pa'i lhag ma i ༷/ e o bzhi la dbyangs kyi nges pa mdzad wa / /gsal byed kyang rgya gar gyi yi ge kā li'i sde lnga so so'i bzhi pa gha dzha rte dz+nya lha ste mthug po lnga dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa ṣa lnga ste log pa lnga/ k+ṣa bcas bcu gcig bor ba'i lhag ma nyer gsum gyi steng du/ bod skad la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge stodad du ca cha ja gsum dang / smad du zha za 'a gsum ste drug bsnan pas gsal byed nyer dgu byung ba'i steng du/ dbyangs dang po a yig bsnan pas sum cu tham par gtan la phab pa 'di ni dbye gzhi rtsa ba'i yi ge sum cu tham par grangs nges par mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngon rjes su 'jug pa dang mi 'jug pa'i+o khyad par bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'/ /dang po ni/de las rjes 'jug bcu yin te//de las lnga ni sngon du'ang 'jug/mi 'jug pa ni nyi shu'o//zhes pa ste/ gong gi kā li sum cu po de las rjes su 'jug pa'i yi ge bcu phyungs shing / bcu po de las yi ge lnga ni sngon du'ang 'jug cing /lhag ma sngon rjes gang du'ang mi 'jug pa'i yi ge ni nyi shu tham pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ sde tshan dbye ba dang / rjes

12'jug bshad pa/ sngon 'jug bshad pa/ mi 'jug pa bshad pa'o//dang po ni/kā li phyed dang brgyad sde ni//bzhi bzhi dag tu phye ba las//zhes pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i kā li de dag bzhi re la sde pa rer phyes pas bdun dang / ha a gnyis la phyed pa ste phyed dang bcas pa'i sde pa brgyad du dbye ba ni 'di ltar/ sde pa dang po ka kha ga nga / sde pa gnyis pa ca cha ja nya/ sde pa gsum pa ta tha da na/ sde pa bzhi pa pa pha ba ma/ sde pa lnga pa tsa tsha dza wa/ sde pa drug pa zha za 'a ya/ sde pa bdun pa ra la sha sa / sde pa brgyad pa phyed de ha a gnyis so//gnyis pa rjes 'jug bshad pa ni/dang po gsum pa bzhi pa yi//mas gnyis drug pa'i gsum pa dang //mdun pa la ni sha ma gtogs//rjes 'jug yi be/ bcu ru 'dod//ces pa ste/ gong gi sde pa dang po ka sde dang / gsum pa ta sde dang / bzhi pa pa sde rnams kyi yi ge mas ma gnyis te/ sde pa dang po'i mas ma / ga nga gnyis/ ga3༅ma pa'i mas ma/ da na gnyis/ bzhi pa'i mas ma/

13ba ma gnyis te drug dang / sde pa drug pa zha sde'i yi ge gsum pa/ 'a yig dang / bdun pa ra sde'i nang gi sha ma gtogs ra la sa gsum dang bcas pa phyungs pas/ khyon ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa ste bcu po de rnams rjes 'jug yi ge bcu ru 'dod cing / da sa gnyis ni yang 'jug go/gsum pa/ sngon 'jug bshad pa ni/rjes 'ojug yi ge bcu nyid las//dang pa gsum pa lnga pa drug/bdun pa rnams ni sngon du'ang 'jug/ces pa ste/ rjes 'jug yi ge banā po de nyid las dang po gagasum pa da/ lnga pa ba/ drug pa ma/ bdun pa 'a yig ste lnga po de rnams ni rjes su 'jug par ma zad sngon du'ang 'jug go zhes pa'o//bzhi pa mi 'jug pa bshad pa la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung bye brag gi dbye ba mdo tsam bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ming gzhi gnyis sam gsum sbrel lam//de la dbyangs kyi gzhi ldan yang //gang du'ang 'jug min sbyar ba'ang min//zhes pa ste/ gong gi rjes 'jug phyungs zin pa'i lhag ma ka kha/ ca

14cha ja nya/ ta tha/ pa pha/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za ya/ sha/ ha a ste sngon rjes gang du'ang mi 'jug pa'i ming gzhi kho nar gnas pa nyi shu po de rnams la/kata/ tapha/ chaka lta bu nyis sbrel dang / phakhan/ kazhaza/ lta bu gsum sbrel lam de rnams la dbyangs kyi gzhi ste i la sogs pa'i srog dang ldan pri / kati/ tabu/ cheka/ phakhonya/ kazhiwa lta bu bod skad kyi yi ge la 'byung mi srid la srid na'ang gsung rab kyi tha snyad gang du'ang 'jug pa min zhing thon mi bdag bi/sa 'dir sbyar ba'ang min no zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa zhar byung bye brag gi dbye ba mdo tsam bshad pa la spyir yi ge sna/ kun slong shes pa dang / rlung g.yos pa las skye zhing / skye ba'i gnas ni khog mgrin rkan so lce mchu spyi bo dang / sna rnams yi ge 'byung ba'i gnas brgyad yin/ zhes pa ltar yi ge rnams spyir khog pa las 'byung zhing / bye brag mgrin pa las byung ba ka kha ga nga ha a/ rkan las byung ba ca cha ja nya tsa tsha dza zha ya sha i e/ so las byung ba ta tha da na za la sa/ mchu las byung ba pa pha ba ma u o/ lce rtse dang nye ba'i spyi bo las ra yig nga nya na ma bzhi rang rang gi gnas la sna dang ldan pa'o/ /de ltar gnas brgyad ni gzhi'i rgyu'o/ /phrad dang cung phrad phye btsum yangs dog gi byed pa drug ni 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu/ kun slong gi rtsol ba ni skul ba'i rgyu/ rlung gi rtsol ba ni bskyod par byed pa'i rgyu ste rgyu bzhi las skye'o/ /srog dang rkyen

15gyi yi ge gnyis las/ srog gi yi ge ni dbyangs bzhi dang tsheg yin/ rkyen gyi yi ge dbu shad gnyis te/ ༄༅༅/ 'di la dbu khyud dang / dang kyogaberka yang zer/ shad ni/ / phur shad/ ༈ོ sbul shad/ // nyis shad/ 1 rin chen spungs shad/ // // bzhi shad rnams so/ /pha ma bu tsha'i yi ge ni pha yig ka nas ha'i bar nyer dgu/ ma yig a/ bu yig steng na gi gu/ 'greng bu/ rna ru gsum/ 'og na zhabs kyu/ ya btags/ ra btags gsum ste drug go/ 'o/ mo ma ning sogs ni rtags las 'byung ba ltar la de dag nga ro'i rtsa ba 'a ha a gsum gyis dbye'o/ /snyan ngag sbyar rgyan sogs la dgos pa'i 'jam rtsub kyi yi ge ni ka ca ta pa tsa ga ja da ba dza nga nya na ma wa 'a ya ra la a ste nyi shu ni 'jam pa dang / yang ba/ srog chung / lhod pa/ mnyen pa yi ge mchodag ces bya'o/ /kha cha tha pha tsha zha za sha sa ha ste bcu ni rtsub pa dang / lci ba/ srog chen/ dam pa/ gyong ba/yi ge dman pa zhes bya'o/ /dbyangs a i ༷/ e tre/ rnams srog chen du bzhed pa'ang yod do/ /'phul 'jug ni/ gas 'phul ca nya ta da na tsa zha za ya sha sa ste bcu gcig das 'phul ka ga nga pa ba ma ste drug bas 'phul ka ga ca ta da tsa zha za sha sa rnams la rkyang pa dang / nga nyi na ja dza rnams la brtsegs 'phul te bsdoms pas bco lnga bcas 'di rnams las nga nya na ma bzhi ma gtogs sna med sha stag go/ mas 'phul kha ga nga cha ja 'u

16tha da na tsha dza ste bcu gcig 'as 'phul kha ga cha ja tha da pa ba tsha dza bcas bcu ste/ 'a mas 'phul tshe sna ldan du klog go/ brtsegs ma las ra mgo can rka rga rnga rja rnya rta rda rna rba rma rtsa rdza bcu gnyis dang / la mgo can lka lga lnga lca lja lta lda lpa lba lha bcas bcu/ sa mgo can ska sga snga snya sta sda sna spa sba sma stsa bcas bcu gcig 'asnga gas can las ya btags can kya khya gya pya phya bya mya bcas bdun/ ra btags can kra khra gra tra thra dra rba pra phra bra mra shra sra hra ste bcu bzhi/ la btags can kla gla bla zla rla sla bcas drug wa btags can kwa khā ga cwa ྅ dwa twa tshwa zhwa zu rwa lwa sha su twa bcas bco lnga/ ra mgo ya btags can rkya rgya rmya bcas gsum/ sa masgo ya btags can skya sgya spya sbya smya ste lnga/ sa mgo ra btags can skra sgra snra spra sbra smra dang drug ra mgo wa btags can rtsa bcas so/ /'phul mi 'thob pa'i yi ge wa 'a ra la ha a bcas drug bshad kyang ra la gnyis la brtsegs tshe 'phul bas lhag ma bzhi ni 'phul med du nges so/ /de ltar yi ge'i tshogs rnams gang du 'jug pa'i gnas ni brgyad de/sgra skad ming dang mtshan ma brda tha snyad//tshig don yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad yin//zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa yi ge'i sbyor ba dngos kyi ming tshig gi 'jug pa bstan pa la gnyis/ rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad rnam dbye

17'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa dang / rjes 'jug la ma ltos pa'i phrad rkyang rang dbang can bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bdun/ rnam dbye dang po dang 'brel ba'i slar bsdu bshad pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs kyi la don bshad pa/ rnam dbye drug pa i ldan gyi 'brel sgra bshad pa/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa gro'i sgra bshad pa/ de dag gi yi ge sbyor tshul las 'phros nas tshig rgyan sogs bshad pa/ rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs bshad pa/ rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa'i sgra bshad pa'o//dang po ni/rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po ni//ming gang gi ni mthar sbyar ba//de la ā li bzhi pa sbyar//slar bsdu bar ni shes par bya//zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de rnams ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar ba sku da kyang / de rnams la ā li bzhi pa o yig ste/ rna ru sbyar ba ni skabs babs kyi brjod bya'i don de tsam gyis bsdus pas slar bsdu'am rdzogs tshig ces kyang bya'o/ /de yang / dper na/ ming rkyang /'brug glang / 'du byed/ yon tan/ shes rab/ lam/ dga'/gser/ dngul/ 'dus byas sogs gang dang gang gi mthar rjes 'jug

18rang 'drar o yig sbyar bas go ngo do no bo mo 'o ro lo so zhes pa'i phrad sbyar te/ 'brug go /glang ngo / /'du byed do/ /yon tan no/ /shes rab bo//lam mo/ /dga' 'o/ /gser ro/ /dngul lo/ /'dus byas so/ /zhes dang shugs bstan da drag gi dbang gis phyind to/ /gyurd to/ /lcald to lta bu rgya cher sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /de yang yi ge dang / ming dang /tshig se gas kyi mtshan nyid shes pa gal che bas mdo tsam brjod na/ yi ge zhes pa'i don ming tshig gi rtsom gzhir gyur nga/'i skad kyi gdangs tsam la sa/sungs pas/ don gang yang mi ston pa'i sgra spyi snang ba yi ge'i mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ ka la sogs pa rnams te/ de la dngos btags kyi sgo nas dbye na sgra dang gzugs gnyis su yod cing / gzugs ni kā li sum cu lta bu ste/ de re re la sgra'i nga ro mi 'dra ba re re 'byung ba sogs bye brag gi dbye pa mtha' yas pa rnams so/ /yi ge de dag 'dus pa las ming 'grub ste/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra spyi snang ba ming gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni chodas/ ka ba/ bum pa la sogs pa'o/ /dbye na 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming dang / rjes grub btags pa'i ming sogs dang ming dang ming rkyang gi khyad par rnams so/ /ming du ma 'dus pa las snga na gyi khyad par ston pa'i sgra spyi snang ba tshig gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ chodas kyi khams/ ka ba brtan po lta bu rnams so/ /tshig la dbye na/ rnam dbye dang / tshig phrad/

19tshig rgyan/ tshig bsdu la sogs pa yi ge'i sgra sbyor tshul gyi dbang gis du mar 'gyur ba rnams so/ /ming tshig de dag la rnam dbye'i phrad sbyar bas sbyar yul don gyi ldog/ pa mi 'dra bar 'gyur bas na don gyi ldog pa ston pa'i sgra spyi snang ba rnam dbye'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni rnam dbye'i gnas brgyad rnams so/ /de yang rnam dbye zhes pa las dang byed pa sogs don gyi khyad par rnam par dbye ba dang / gcig gnyis mang sngo sogs tshig gi rnam grangs rnam par dbye bsdo/ na de ltar brjod do/ /dbye ba ni gcig tshig la sogs pa'o/ /'di rnams tshig grogs la ltos dbo sa mi dgos kyi khyad par yod de/ dper na/ sangs rgyas la zhes pa'i la yig gi phrad de rnam dbye yin kyang tshig grogs ma sbyar na rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun gang du 'gyur ma ngengashrī pa lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis lta bur tshig grogs la ma ltos par rnam dbye'i rkyen sbyar ba tsam gyis rnam dbye de dang der go nus pa byed 'brel 'byung khungs la sogs pa ste 'og nas 'byung ba'i dper brjod rnams kyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /legs sbyar kyi skad la rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig sbyar pa na/ ming tsam du ma bsdad par tshig tu gyub pa yin kyang / bod 'dir ming rkyang tsam la rnam dbye dang po zhes bya zhing / 'og nas 'byung ba'i la don sogs la sgra sbyor gyi dbang gi rnam dbye'i go rim nges med du 'byung bas 'dir thog mar rnam dbye brgyad rnams go rim ltar shes dgos

20la / der mi gtogs pa'i tshig phrad rnams kyang rnam dbye dang tshig phrad tha dad du dbye ba'i phyir shes dgos pas de gnyis mdor bsdus su dgos la/thog mar rnam dbye brgyad kyi sdom tshig ni/dang po ngo bo gnyis pa las kyi sa//gsum pa byed pa bzhi pa dgos ched sa//lnga pa 'byung khungs drug pa 'brel ba'i sa//bdun pa gnas gzhi brgyad pa 'ange da pa'i sa//zhes pa ste de re re la gcig tshig nyid dang / gnyis tshig dag mang tshig rnams sbyar bas nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'gyur tshul sku gas sku da la/ rnam dbye de rnams ji lta bu'i tshul gyis rnam dbye'i gnas su gyur zhe na/ ming de'i ngo bo tsam las khyad par gang yang mi ston pa ni rnam dbye dang po ngo bo tsam ston pa ste/ sangs rgyas lta bucad/ /byed pa pos bya ba la sbyor ba na bya ba'i ༷/la lam las kyi tshig gtso bor byas pa ni gnyis pa las su bya ba sde/ sangs rgyas la bsten lta bu'o/ /byed pa pos bya ba la spyor ba na byed pa po'i tshig gtso bor byas pa ni/ gsum pa byed pa po'i gnas ste/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs lta bu'o/ /byed pa pos bya ba la sbyor ba na bya ba'i yul de'am de dang 'brel ba'i las dang byed pa gang rung la phan 'dogs pa'i dbo sa pa gang gi ched du bya ba byas par ston pa'i ngag ni/ bzhi pa dgos

21ched de/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas bsgrub lta bu'o/ /dngos po gang zhig gang las 'byung ba'i khungs ston pa'i sgra ni lnga pa 'byung khungs ste/sangs rgyas las chos lta bu'o/ /dngos po gang zhig khyad gzhi khyad dzadas kyi tshul du 'brel ba brjod pa ni drug pa 'brel ba'i sa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan lta bu'o/ /chos gang zhig gang la gnas pa'am yod pa dang ldan pa tsam ston pa ni bdun pa gnas gzhi'i sgra ste/ sangs rgyas la yon tan mnga' lta bu'o/ /ming gi thog mar 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar ba ni brgyad pa 'bod pa'i gnas ste/ kye sangs rgyas rnams lta bu'o/ /rnam dbye 'di dag la bdun dang bcu sogs kyi dbye bsdu yod kyang spyi tsam du gong ltar ro/ /tshig phrad ces pa ni rnam dbye de dag tu mi gtogs pa'i slar bsdu dang / rgyan sdud/ lhag bcas/ 'byed sdud/ dgar sdud/ ni sgra/ dang sgra/ de sgra/ gang sgra/ bdag sgra/ dgag sgra rnams kyi rkyen gyi yi ge sbyar ba 'dir bstan rnams dang gzhan yang nyid dang / kho na/ ci/ 'di/ su/yang / nam/ slar/ cod na/ la la/ ji/ tsam la sogs pa phrad rkyang rnams dang / phrad gnyis gsum sogs 'dus pa gang dag de dag gang rnams/ de rnams/ ji snyed/ de snyed/ ci nas kyang / gang gi tshe na la sogs pa smra sgo las gsungs pa rnams te des na rnam dbye dang tshig phrad ma 'dres pa shes par bya zhing zhib par 'di la mu bzhi'i dbye ba yang yod do//

22 gnyis pa la don gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs bshad pa la gnyis/'jug pa'i yi ge ngos bzung ba dang / de rnams kyi 'jug pa bstan pa'o//dang po ni/rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po las//gang ming mtha' na bcu pa gnas//de la gnyis pa u yang sbyar//gang ming mtha' na ga3/ma pa gnas//de la ā li gnyis pa sbyar//bzhi pa dgu pa dngos kyang ste//zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po las/ /gang yang rung ba'i mig gi mtha' na rjes 'jug bcu pa sa yig gnas shing de dang mthun pa'i sa yig la ā li gnyis pa ༷/ sbyar bas/ su/ zhes grub pa dang gang yang rung ba'i mig gi mtha' na rjes 'jug brgyad pa la don gyi ra yig gnas pa de nyid la ā li gnyis pa u sbyar bas/ ru dang / gang yang rung ba'i mig gi mtha' na rjes 'jug gsum pa da yig gnas shing / de dang mthun pa'i da yig la ā li gnyis pa u sbyar bas/ du dang / rjes 'jug bzhi pa na dang / dgu pa la yig gnyis po dngos kyang ste/ dbyangs sbyar ba la ma ltos par 'og gi don rnams la 'jug cing / 'dir da drag gi mthar tu 'thob

23pa ste bdun po 'di rnams la la don gyi rnam dbye zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la don gyi yi ge de dag rnam dbye gang la 'jug pa bstan pa ni/las dang ched dang rten gnas dang //de nyid tshe skabs la sgra yi//zhes pa ste/ la don gyi yi ge su ra ru du na la da drag la tu bcas bdun po de dag gang la 'jug na rnam dbye gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa/ bdun pa/ gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang // bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs bcas lnga la 'jug cing la yi sgra dang mthun pa yin no/ /de dag 'jug pa'i tshul yang / sgra yi 'jug tshul dang / don gyi 'jug tshul gnyis yod pa'i dang po sgra'i 'jug tshul ni/ ming mtha' gang la sbyor ba'i nges pa ste/sa sde/ ga ba da drag tu//nga da na ma ra la du//'a dang mtha' med ra dang ru//zhes pa ltar nges pa byed dgos so/ /gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul ni/ gzhung gi dngos bstan rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs don lnga la ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul te/ su ra ru du na la tu ste bdun po de rnams rim pa bzhin du rnam dbye gnyis pa'i don la 'jug tshul/ dper na/ shar phyogs su 'gro/ lhor lta/ dge ba mtha' ru bskyal/ rgya gar du slebs/ mdun na

24rgyu/ gzugs la lta/ phyi rold tu phyin lta bu ste byed pa po yul gang la bya ba bye+od pa'i tshe bya yul gyi las gsal bar byed pa'i tshig thams cad la sbyar ra//bzhi pa dgos ched ni bya yul dang byed po gang rung gi ched du byas pa'i dgos pa gsal byed kyi sgra su sogs la'i sgra dang mthun pa rnams ste/dper na/ mtho ris su smon lam btab/ rig gnas slob par dam bcas/thar pa thob pa ru bdag med sgom/ gzhan dodan du dge ba bsgrub/ rgyan la gser brdung / tshogs na mang ja bsgol/ thar pa skrub byed du nges 'byung bskyed lta bu dgos pa gang zhig gi ched dang / phyir dang / slad dang / don te dgos ched gsal byed kyi sgra la dang mthun pa thams cad la 'jug pacad//rnam dbye bdun pa'i don la 'jug tshul ni/ dper na/ byang phyogs su chos yod/ shar lhor me lha gnas/ lho ru gshin rje/ shar du rgya naganub na ༷/ rgyan/ steng la rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor/ rgyal khab tu chos srid brtan lta bu ste/ rten gang la brten pa'am yod pa'i don rnams la 'jug go/rnam dbye gnyis pa'i bye brag de nyid la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/skyabs su mchi/ sems su shar/ lhar gsal/ sra ru song / 'od du 'bar/ lta na sdug so na gnas/ sems na nges/ don la snyeg gong 'phel la song / blo la nges/ yid la goms/ bag la nyal/ gyen la

25'phyur/ don la gnas/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag skyob tu re/ rab tu byung / skad cig la 'char/ rnam bcad la khegs/ yongs gcod la grub/ lta bu ste/ las dang bya ba tha mi dad pa'i rang gi de kho na nyid bden par ston pa'i don can rnams la 'jug go /na la gnyis de nyid la 'jug pa 'di ni rtsa ba mkhan po'i dgongs pa yin cing / 'jug tshul yang gong gi dpes mchodan par nus shing smra sgo las mi 'jug par gsungs pa ni khyab chung ba tsam la dgongs pa yin pas gnyis ka'i dgongs pa mthun phyogs su go bar bya yi 'gal 'dur mi gzung ngo / /bdun pa'i bye brag tshe skabs kyi don la 'jug pa ni/ tshes gnyis su nyi ma ldog snga mor gyon/ zla ba bcu ru bltams/ nyin gung du chos ston drangs/ nyi nub tu lha 'du/ de'i dus na tshogs 'khor bya/ srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par gzhag tho rangs na sangs rgyas/ sku/ drug tu dka' ba spyad/ cig car tu rtogs/ dus kun tu bde/ lta bu ste/gtso bor tshe dang skabs kyi don du la yig 'jug rung du yod pa'i dus brjod pa'i don thams cad la 'jug go/'dir smra sgo las na'i 'jug pa bcu bzhi tsam gsungs ste/ dang po dmigs kyis 'byed pa ni dgar ba dang don gcig ste/ 'di la gal 'dzugs pa dang / gzhung 'dzugs pa gnyis las/ gal 'dzugs pa ni/ yin

26grang na zhes snga ma mtha' gnyis logs su bcad nas phyi ma la don gcig gal dmigs su 'dzin pa lta bu'o/ /gzhung 'dzugs pa ni dngos su na/ zhe na / mdor bsdu na/ lta bu/ gzhung gi don khyad par du bton nas dmigs 'byed pa'o/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung lta bu'am/ byas pa na mi rtag go lta bu byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi rtag par sgrub pa dang nge na gcig go /rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa ni/ 'dir shing nyid med na shing sha pa gang zhig yod lta bu dang / 'dus byas yin na mi 'jig pa ga la sku da lta bu'am/ 'dir du ba med na me ji ltar yod ces pa rgol ba gzhan la me med par bsgrub pa'i tshe/ dngos su du ba med na me ji ltar yod/ ces dris nas me yod pa dgagre nas shugs la me sku/da pa'i rgyu mtshan nam gtan tshigs du ba yod dgos pa na yig gis thon pa lta bu'o/ /tshig phyi ma'i don snga ba'i don de las gzhan du ston pa/ sngon sdig can zhig yin na da ni dge ba la gnas par byed do lta bu'o/ /'os par dka' ba'i tshig gam tshod 'dzin pa ni/ tshig snga mar 'os par dka' ba sbyar nas tshig phyi ma nges pa'i don sbyar ba/ lhas btud na mis lta ci thi+os lta bu'am/ dpon gyis las byed na g.yog gis lta ci smos lta bu'o/ /de las ldog pa ni snga mar 'os pa bkod nas/ phyi mar mi 'os pa sbyar te tshig phyi ma nges pa'i don sbyar ba/g.yog las byed na dpon yang las byed do lta bu'am/ nyi mas sreg par

27byed na zla ba'ang de lta bur mthong ngo lta bu'o/ /'gal ba'ang mi 'gal bar ྅ na pa ni/ mi mthun pa'i rgyan ston pa ste/ kun rdzob du sku da na don dam par ni yod pa ma yin no/ /lta bu'o/ /smon pa'i don du sbyar ba ni/ bdag byang chub thob na snyam mo lta bu dang / sems can bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung / ldan par gyur cig lta bu'o/ /dri ba'i don du sbyar ba ni/ bum pa yod na de ji ltar yod lta bu dang / gzugs gzugs su rung ba yin na 'di cis gzugs su rung lta bu'o/ /the tshom gyi gzhi ni/ myu gu la rgyu dgos na rgyu gcig gam du ma dasos zhes pa gnyis su dogs pa lta bu'o//tshe skabs sogs bzhi ni gong du bshad pa ltar blo / /la yig kyang 'dir ma bshad pa sdud pa dang / mtshams sbyor dang / smon pa dang / tshad 'dzin pa bzhi la 'jug par bshad de/ sdud pa ni/ lag pa bsnyal la zas za lta bu'am/ mnyam par gzhag la bsgam par bya/ lta bu lhag bcas dang 'dra'o/ /tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba ni/ gsal zhing dwangs la dri ma med lta bu'am/ 'dir me yod la 'dir med do lta bu'o/ /smon pa ni/ bdag nam zhig na 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur la gyur nas kyang lta bu'o/ /tshad 'dzin ni/ ji tsam la/ de tsam la zhes pa lta bu ste tshad 'dzin ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams lhag bcas dang 'dra' //gsum pa rnam dbye drug pa i ldan bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor

2ོ8ོbstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'//dang po ni/rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po ni//i dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya//zhes pa ste/ ming mtha'i yi ge bcu po de rnams ni dbyangs i sbyar bas rnam dbye drug pa dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya'o zhes pa'o//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/dang po gnyis la dang po mthun//gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar//bdun pa nyid la bdun pa ste//lhag ma rnams la gya sbyar ba//de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa//zhes pa ste/ ming gi mthar rjes 'jug dang po ga dang / gnyis pa nga gnas pa la drug pa'i sgra 'dren pa'i tshe dang po gnyis la ga mthun zhing ming mthar rjes 'jug gsum pa da dang / lnga pa ba/ drug pa sa gnas pa la kya dang sbyar bar bya la/ bdun pa 'a nyid kho na gnas pa la bdun pa 'a nyid sbyar bar bya ste/ de'i lhag ma na ma ra la rnams gnas pa la gya sbyar ba mthun zhing / de dag la dbyangs dang po i sbyar bas gi kyi 'i gyi zhes

29byung ba de rnams don gang gi sa'am gnas la 'jug ce na rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba la 'jug ste/ 'di la sgra yi 'jug tshul ni/da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi//'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i//rkang pa skong tshe yi 'thob bo//zhes pa ltar sbyor tshul nges pa bya'o/ /don gyi 'jug tshul ni/ s+t+rir 'brel ba zhes pa'i don go dka' zhing gnad che bas 'di'i mtshan nyid sogs cung zad bshad na/ tha dad gang las tha dad pa de log na cig shos ldog par nges pa de 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni bum pa dang shes bya gnyis lta bu'o/ /de la dbye na bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba dang / de las de byung gi 'brel ba gnyis te/ dang po ni/ ngo bo tha dad ma yin pa'i tha dad gang las tha dad pa de log na cig shos ldog par nges pa de bdag gcig 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa dang dngos po gnyis te bum pa'i gzugs lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdzas tha dad pa gang las tha dad pa de log na cig shos ldog par nges pa de de byung 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ me du gnyis te me'i du ba lta bu'o/ /de'i snga ma ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad khyab bya khyab byed du 'brel ba'o/ phyi ma ni rdzas

30tha dad bskyed bya skyed byed rgyu 'bras su 'brel ba'o/ /dang po la rnam grangs kyi dbye ba ni/ khyab bya khyab byed kyi 'brel ba/ rten 'byung gi 'brel ba/gzhi mthun gyi 'brel ba/ spyi dang bye brag gi 'brel ba/ chos dang chos can gyi 'brel ba sku gas dang / gnyis pa la rnam grangs kyis dbye na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba/ khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi 'brel ba/ rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba/ yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba/ bdag lnga dang rdzas kyi 'brel ba / yul dang yul can gyi 'brel ba sogs dang / gzhan yang brjod bya rjod byed/ ming dang tshig tshig dang don snga phyi sogs ltos 'jog gi 'brel ba rnams kyang gong gi khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /de ltar spyi don nges par byas nas rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra'i dper brdzod dngos ni/ gong gi yi ge'i sgra sbyor gyi go rim ltar dang po gnyis la dang po mthun pa'i dpe ni/ bdag gi mig rang gi gzugs lta bu'o/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar ba ni/ khyod kyi nor/ rab kyi phul/ las kyi rnam smin lta bu'o//bdun pa nyid la bdun pa mthun pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa/nga'i lus lta bu brda rnying la 'a mtha' sbyar ba yod kyang skad gsar bcad la yi ge zor yang ba'i phyir bsdus kyang don thob tu yod dgos par rtsa ba mkhan pe'i dgongs pa'o/ /lha ga ma rnams la gya sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ gtan gyi skyabs/yum gyi dgongs pa/ gter gyi mdzod/ zhal gyi sgo lta bu'o/ /da drag gi

31dbang gis thob pa'i dpe ni/ rnam thard kyi sgo/ phyi rold kyi khang pa sogs dang / 'di dang bya ba gcig pa tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa kha skong la yi sbyor ba ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /lta bu dang /gang ming mtha' dang mthun pa yi lta bu'o/ /da drag gi mthar kyi sbyor ba ni/pho yis sgyu yi ming mtha' drangs pa'o/ /'dir dngos su ma bshad kyang kyi la sogs pa'i 'jug pa rnam dbye drug pa ma yin pa gzhan yang yod de/ de lta mod kyi lta bu mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / mi rtag pa yin gyi rtag pa ma yin no/ /lta bu/ nge na de kho na nges par bzung nas gzhan 'gog pa la 'jug pa dang / 'di ni bden gyi gzhan ni gti mug go lta bu dang / 'di ni rgyu las 'byung gi rgyu med po las ma yin no lta bu mang du 'byung ba de dag drug sgra dang ma nar bar bya'//bzhi pa rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i sgra bshad pa ni/de nyid la ni bcu pa sbyar// byed pa'i sar ni shes par bya//zhes pa ste gong gi rnam dbye drug par 'jug pa'i gi kyi gyi 'i yi bcas la rjes 'jug bcu pa sa yig sbyar bas gis kyis gyis 'is yis zhes grub pa de ni rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa zhes bya ba byed pa po'i sgra gtso bor ston pa'i rnam dbye'o/ /sa zhes pa gnas kyi don ste byed pa po ston pa'i

32gnas su shes par bya'o/ /byed pa po'i gnas su ji ltar 'gyur ba dper na / bdag gis thos/ rang gis byas/ khyod kyis bshad/ shes rab kyis dpyad/ sras kyis nyan/ sems dpa'is bslabs/ gzhan gyis go dgra bcom gyis spangs/ gser gyis nyos/ zhal gyis bzhes lta bu'o/ /shugs la bstan pa da drag gi mthar/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba/ rab 'byord kyis gsol ba/ pha rold kyis bshad lta bu yod kyang /gsar bcad la da drag bsdus pas de dag la gyis zhes bri srol du chags shing / gsar bcad la byang chub sems dpas bslabs/ bla mas bskyabs/bu+om pos chu bcus sogs ming mthar sa yig rkyang pa sbyar bas kyang byed pa sku:na na//lnga pa rnam dbye de dag gi yi ge'i spyor tshul las 'phros nas tshig rgyan sdudags 'chad pa la gsum/ rgyan sdud bshad pa/ lhag bcas bshad pa / 'byed sdud bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ ā li phyis nas gnyis pa sbyar//tshig rgyan gnyis dang sdud par 'gyur//zhes nga/ ste gong du rnam dbye drug pa'i sgra dngos su bstan pa'i kyi 'i gnyis dang / shugs la kha skong gi yi bcas gsum gyi ā li ste i phyis

33nas rjes 'jug gnyis pa nga yig sbyar bas/ kyang 'ang yang zhes grub pa de ni mthun pa dang / mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gnyis dang / sdud pa'i don la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de la yi ge'i sgra spyor ni/ga da ba sa drag mthar kyang//nga na ma ra la mthar yang //'a dang mtha' med 'ang dang yang //zhes pa ltar/ dper na/ bokag kyang / bcad kyang / bkab kyang / byas kyang / bstand kyang / 'byard kyang / bstsald kyang / lha'ang /lha yang / gang yang / lam yang / yin yang / dgar yang / gsal yang lta bu rgya cher sbyar ro/ /de dag don gyi 'jug tshul la mthun pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig la sdud cing / khyad par tshig mdzes par byed pa ste/ dper na/ mdzes pa'ang yin te mdog kyang dkar/dpal yang 'bar la yid kyang 'phrog ces pa lta bu'o/ /mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig la sdud cing khyad par tshig mdzes par byed pa ste/ dper na/ phyogs ris med kyang bdud dpung 'joms/ 'ching ba spangs kyang thugs rjes bsdams/ chags pa bral yang 'ahro la chags/ lta bu'o/ /tshig rgyan du mi 'gyur ba'i sdud pa la yang khyad gzhi khyad chos gong 'og gnyis kas phan tshun sdud pa/ usgraṇal yang yin

34sngon po'ang yin lta bu gzhi mthun par sdud pa dang / chos kyang dran te chos ma yin pa min no lta bu gong mas 'og ma sdud pa dang / lhas char phab ste klus kyang 'beb bo lta bu 'og mas gong ma sdud pa'o/ /yang gi don ni/ yang na 'di bya ste lta bu rnam grangs bsnan pa'i don du 'jug pa dang / yang dang yang du dang / yang nas yang du/ slar yang / de nas yang sogs bskyar ba'i don la 'jug ste/ bskyar ba ni don snga ma nyid bldabs pa yin la/ sdud pa ni don snga ma bldabs pa tsam ma yin par bya ba dang/ byed pa dang / dgag pa dang / skrub pa la sogs pa'i khyad par rnams don/ snga phyi'i sbyor ba sdud par byed pa'o// lhag bcas dang sdud pa'i khyad par yang / don gyi gzhi snga mar gang sbya ra ba'i bya ba la sogs pa'i khyad par de dag phyi mar yang nges can du sbyor ba ni sdud pa ste/ dper na/ monabyupa 'bras za'o// rgya gar ba yang 'bras za'o lta bu bya ba'i khyad par 'bras za ba gzhi gnyis kar sbyar nas gnyis ka'am gang rung la yang sogs sdud tshig sbyar rung gi mo na pa 'bras za'o/ rgya gar ba khrus byed do lta bu 'bras za ba dang khrus byed pa khyad par mi mthun pas gzhi mi mthun pa la sbyor ba sdud tshig sbyar mi rung ngo //lhag bcas ni/ gzhi tha dad pa du ma la sbyor ba'i nges bzung mi dgos par don snga ma ma rdzogs par lhag ma yod pa tsam rnyedan pa'o//gnyis pa lhag bcas ni/

35la don su la u phyis nas//de la gsum pa'i dang po sbyar//de la ā li gsum pa sbyar//de ni lhag ma dang bcas pa'o//zhes pa ste/ gong gi la'i sgra dang mthun pa'i su yig la de'i srog gi dbyangs u phyis nas/ sa rkyang du gnas pa de la sde pa gsum pa'i dang po ta yig sbyar bas/ sta zhes 'byung ba de la ā li gsum pa e sbyar bas ste zhes grub pa de ni tshig don snga ma ma rdzogs par slar tshig lhag ma gzhan lton rgyu yod pa la 'jug pas/ lhag ma dang bcas pa'i sgra'o zhes 'dir dngos su bstan pa dang ma bstan pa'i rjes 'jug gi ming mtha'i dbang gis lhag bcas la te rkyang dang de sbyor ba'ang yod de/ de dag gi sgra'i 'jug tshul ni/na ra la sa drag mthar te//da de ga nga ba ma 'a//mtha' me da rnams la sa ste 'thob//ces pa ltar/ na ra la sa dang / da drag gi mthar te rkyang pa sbyar ba / byon te/ bskor te/ nor bcol te/ byas te/ bstand te/ bsgyurd te / bsald te lta bu da mthar de sbyar ba yod de gzhung las 'di bshad

36de lta bu dang / ga nga ba ma 'a mtha' med la sa ste sbyar ba/ rtag ste/ gtsang ste/ lhan grub ste/ 'dzom ste/ dga' ste/ sems bde ste lta bu'o// phrad de dag gis ji lta ra 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi don ni gsum ste/ mtshams sbyor dang / dam bca' dang / gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas so/ dang po/mtshams sbor la'ang gsum ste/ dang po mda' 'phangs te phog lta bu tshig snga ma byed pa dang phyi ma bya ba gnyis rim gyis 'jug pa'i bar gyi mtshams sbyor dang / gnyis pa lha mchod de las bya lta bu bya ba snga phyi gnyis rim gyis 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor dang / gsum pa 'dzum dmul te mdangs phyung lta bu gnyis ka bya ba yin yang dus snga phyi med par lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor ba bcas so// gnyis pa dam bca' 'dren pa ni/ tshig snga ma bsgrub bya dang phyi ma sgrub byed du bkod pa zhig ste/ de la'ang nang gses su dbye na bzhi yod de/ dang po dbye ba 'dren pa ni/ dkon mchog ni gsum ste sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun no lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan 'dren pa ni/ rtag pa yin te 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir/mi rtag ste byas pa'i phyir lta bu'o// gsum pa nges tshig 'dren pa ni/ dgra bcom pa zhes bya ste nyon mongs kyi dgra bcom pa'i chos dang ldan pas so//sangs rgyas te ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs shing shes bya la lho gros rgyas pa'o lta bu'o// bzhi pa rgyas bshad dam rnam grangs kyi dbye ba 'dren pa ni/

37bslab pa ni 'di lta ste nang pa la grags pa'i nyan rang sangs rgyas theg gsum gyi bslab pa gsum/ de re re la tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum gsum dang / phyi rol pa'i tshangs spyo /da kyi bslab pa la sogs pa'o lta bu/ gsum pa gzhan 'dren lhag bcas ni/ mtshams sbyor dang dam bca' gnyis su ma gtogs pa'i tshig lhag ma sku da tsam ston pa zhig ste/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams go lar g.yon skor du rgyu ste dgra gcan ni goyas skor du'o/ /zhes pa lta bu/ snga ma las gzhan du 'dren pa rna64tra/ sa//gsum pa 'byed sdud bshad pa ni/rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po la//drug pa sbyar na 'byed sdud yin//zhes pa ste rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po so so la rjes 'jug gi drug pa ma yig sbyar bas/ gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am ram lam sam zhes grub pa dang / da drag mthar tam 'thob pa bcas yi ge bcu gcig po de rnams tshig don so sor 'byed pa'am phyogs gcig tu sdud pa'i sgra la 'jug pa yin no/ /de dag ming mthar sbyor tshul slar bsdu'i skabs dang 'dra ste rtag gam/ ma17nga ngan// ku+onod dam/ 6pen nam/ chab bam/ bsamyo/ phyo/ma/dga' 'am/ 'byor ram/ tshul lam/ byas sam/ bu'am bcas dang /

38da drag la 'dzin tam la sogs pa lta buso// /de rnams don la sbyor tshul ni/ 'byed pa la 'jug pa dbye gzhi gcig las bye brag gnyis su 'byed pa / dper na/ chos ni gnyis te 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas sku lta bu dang / dngos po ni gsum ste bem po'am/ shes pa'am/ ldan min 'du byed do lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du mang por 'byed pa phung po ni lnga ste gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o lta bu dang / tshig don gnyis ka don gcig tu sdud pa/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas ni dzadas mo lta bu'o/ /mang po don gcig tu sdud pa gzugs sam/ chodar ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa ni phung po'o lta bu dang / gzhan yang bum pa ni mi rtag ste/ ka ba'am/ snam bu yang ngo lta bu/ chos snga mar sbyar ba phyi mar yang sbyor ba sdud pa dang / bum pa'am/ ka ba'am/ snam bu yang bdag med do lta bu/phyi ma'i chos bdag med pa snga mar sbyor ba sdud ba sogs yod do/ /the tshom gyi nang nas mtha' gnyis po cha mnyam du dogs pa la mtha' gnyis ka bkod nas yin nam min zhes rje ra la/ yin pa la malngaran du phyogs pa'am min pa la shas cher phyogs pa la ni mtha' re re ba rkyang par 'am la sogs pa sbyar te/ de yin nam lta bu ste de dag kyang mtha' gnyis po dngos su 'byed pa dang / don gyis 'byed pa ci rigs su yod do/ /da drag gi dbang gis

39ming mtha' drangs pa/ phyind tam/ gyurd tam/ sungapad tam sogs te gong ma bzhin du 'byed sdud du sbyar zhing / dri ba la sbyar ba ni 'byed pa'i sgra nyid do//drug pa rnam dbye lnga pa bshad pa ni/rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi//bzhi pa dgu pa la bcu pa//sbyar ba 'byung khungs sa yin te//dgar dang sdud pa'ang de bzhin no//zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de yi grangs bzhi pa na dang /dasdo/ pa la yig gnyis la ba༄dri pa sa yig sbyar bas/ nas las zhes ༷/ba pa de ni rgeng las byung ba'am bral ba sogs ston pa'i don du 'jug pas na/rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi sa yin zhing 'di ni phrad rang dbang can yin pas rjes 'jug la ma lto sa par thams cad la khyab mnyam du 'jug pa yin no/ /de'ang 'byung khungs dngos la 'jug pa ni/ sangs rgyas las chos/dzadas las 'phags pa'i dza gas/ rgya mtsho las nor bu/ sprin las char pa babs/ gangs ri las chu byung / sa las myu gu skye/ gser kha nas gser/mkhas pa las rig pa lta bu'o/ /yang rta las lhungs/ skas nas babs lta bu 'byung khungs dang cha 'dra ba dang / du ba las mer shes/ chu skyar las

40chur bes lta bu rgyu ma②ོna la 'jug pa de dag kyang 'byung khungs dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /nas las dgar ba la 'jus/ pa ni/ dgar gzhi rigs dang / bya ba/ yon tan dang / rdzas kyi khyad par gang yang rung ba las dgar chos logs su bkar ba ste/ rigs kyi gzhi gcig las logs su dgar ba ni/ dper na/ mi'am ci las dri za tha dad do zhes tha dad tsam du dgar ba dang / mi rigs bzhi las rgyal rigs ni phul du byung ba lta bu mchodag tu dgar ba dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin las ngan song gsum zhan no lta bu dman par dgar ba'o/ /de bzhin du bya ba'i gzhi gcig las logs ྅/ dgar ba ni/ phyag 'tshal ba 'a/sa mnyam par bzhag pa legs lta bu+o dang / bya ba'i gzhi mang po los logs su dgar ba ni/ za ba dang / dgad pa dang// smra ba dang / 'gra ba la sags thams cad las phyag 'tshal ba mdzadag go lta bu dang / sku/na tan gyi gzhi gcig las logs su dgar ba ni/ dkar po las ngur smrig legs lta bu dang / yon tan gyi gzhi mang po las logs su dgar ba ni/ dkar po dang / ser po dang /dmar po las ljang khu legs lta bu dang / rdzas sam dngos po'i chos gcig las logs su dgar ba ni/ sdug bsngal ba las mi rtag pa gzhan lta bu dang /rdzas sam dngos po mang po las 'o/gas su dgar ba ni/ rtag pa dang dngos po'i chos las de bzhin nyid tha dad do/ /lha rnams las rdo rje rtse brgya 'dzin

41pa ni brgya byin no lta bu 'di dag la las kyi sgra nyid 'jug cing / yang tshogs kyi nang nas 'byin lta bu dang / mi'i nang nas rgyal rigs dpa'/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / dzadas lugs kyi nang nas nang pa mchog go lta bu la nas kyi sgra nyid 'jug go /nas kyi sgra sdud pa la 'jug pa ni/'di nas byang r+yāb bar lta bu dus kyi mtshams 'dzin cing sdud pa dang / bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi bar lta bu lam sdud pa dang / brgya nas stong gi bar lta bu grangs sdud pa dang / gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar lta bu dngos po'i mtshams 'dzin cing sdud pa'o/ /las sgra sdud pa la 'jug pa ni/ gser ri las khor yug gi bar/ grong las dgon pa'i bar/ thang las sgang bar lta bu'ang yod cing / nas kyi sgra nyid sda/da pa dang / mtshams sbyor la lhag par ga3/ngas pas/ phyag 'tshal nas bshad/ mda' 'phangs nas 'o/ga lag pa bsnyal nas zas bza' lta bu lhag bcas kyi ste dang / la sgra'i gnas rnams mtshungs par 'jug go/bdun pa 'bod pa'i rnam dbye bshad pa la gnyis/ 'bod pa'i sgra nyid bshad pa dang / 'phros don tshig sdud bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/gang ming brjod pa'i dang po ru//kye sbyar ba ni bod pa yin//zhes pa ste/ gang zag gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i dang po

42ste thog mar kye zhes sbyar ba/ dper na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ kye grogs po / kye lha'i dbang po lta bu/ kye'i sgra ni rnam dbye brgyad pa'i gnas yin no/ /kye sgra tshig gi bar dang tha mar 'jug pa'ang yod de/ 'jam dbyangs mabo na kye bdag la blo gros stsortol lta bu dang / bdag la dgongs shig mgon po kye/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ka ye sogs grong tshig 'bod pa'i sgra dang cha 'dra yod cing / dper brjod 'ga' zhig tu/ kye shing zhes bkod pa 'dug kyang de ni dper mtshon pa tsam la dbo ngas pa yin gyi/ gang zag la ma gtogs mi 'jug go/gnyis pa 'phros don tshig sdud bshad pa ni/ 'dir tshig gi tshogs pa'i cha nas tshig sdud kyi dpe don mdo tsam bshad pa la/ de yang tshig sdud ces bya ba ni/ ming ngam rtags la su sdudags kyi rnam dbye phyis nas tshig tu grub pa'i ming gnyis sam mang po phyogs gcig tu sdud pa la tshig sdud ces bya ste/ 'di la drug dang po las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos so so ba gzhi mthun par bsdu ba ste/ dper na/ tsan dan yang yin/ dkar po yang yin lta bu la las gzhi dang las kyi khyad chos phyogs gcig tu 'dzin pas mthun par sdud pa la/ tsan dan dkar po zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ba gnyis kyi bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bgrang bya dang grangs yin par bsdu ste/ dper na/ phung po yang yin/ lnga yang

43yin zer rgyu la/ ba ni skad dod yin pas don du mar 'jug kyang / 'dir bgrang bar bya ba dang grangs gnyis brjod bya 'brel bar bsdus pas/ phung po lnga zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba ni/ ming dang tshig gi bar gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs bsdu ba ste/ dper na/ lam du 'gro/zhes zer rgyu la/ tha snyad dngos dze dus kyi nus pas bsdus pa la/ lam 'gro zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye gnyis pa bsdu ba dang / kha sna gnyis kyis 'thung ba la gnyis 'thung zhes gsum pa bsdu ba dang / lus las 'bras bu blangs pa'i ched du sbyin pa la/ lus sbyin lta bu bzhi pa bsdu ba dang / mngal las skyes pa la/ mngal skyes zhes lnga pa bsdu ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od la nyi 'od lta bu drug sgra bsdu ba dang / sems la gnas pa la sems gnas lta bu rnam dbye bdun pa bsdu ba rnams so/ /bzhi pa 'byu mang gi bsdu ba ni/ ming gnyis sam mang po yang rung ma bsdus pa'i skabs kyi brjod bya las/ don gzhan dang 'brel bar ston byed du bsdu ba ste/ dper na/ gang ba dang zag pa zhes zer rgyu la/ ming gi 'bru ci yod rnams brjod don dang 'brel bar bla thabs su bsdus pas gang zag ces shed bu'i ming gcig ston pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa zlas dbye'i bsdu ba ni/ ming gnyis sam mang po yang rung bar gyi rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas thams cad kyi mthar rnam dbye gcig sbyar ba ste/ dper na/ mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub pa brnyes pa'i bla

44ma'i zhal nas zer rgyu la snga ma'i rnam dbye zlas bsdus te/ mkhas pa rkyaṇ+ḍa3 ta grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma'i zhal nas zhes pa lta bu'o/ drug pa mi zad pa'i bsdu ba ni/ tshig sdud gang gi thog mar mi zad pa'i rtags kyi brjod bya gtso bor ston pa'i bsdu ba ste/ rgya gar gyi skad la/ u ba kum+bha zhes pa'i u ba nye ba'i zhes snga mar gtso bor brjod cing / kum+bha zhes phyis brjod pa'i bar gyi rnam dbye dang po phyis pa yin yang / bod kyi byings 'dir rnam dbye dang po 'di zhes zur du ster rgyu med pas/ nye ba'i bum pa zhes brjod pa las/ mi zad pa'i rtags kyis brjod bya ston pa med do/ /zhes 'grel ba 'phrul lde las gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir tshig gi tshogs pa'i kha skong du mdor bsdus tsam bris shing / rgyas par shes 'ange da na tshogs gsum gsal ba dang / smra sgo mtshon cha sogs su blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshig phrad rkyang pa rang dbang can kho na bshad pa la drugani sgra dgar brnan gyi tshig bshad pa/ dang sgra 'byed sdud sogs bshad pa/de sgra tha snyad sogs kyi don la 'jug tshul bshad pa/ gang sgra spyir 'jug gi don bshad pa/ pa sogs bdag wa'i sgra bshad pa/ ma mi sogs dgag pa'i sgra bshad pa'o//dang po ni/gang ming mtha' dang mthun pa yi//

45bzhi pa la ni i sbyar ba//dgar dang brnan pa'i tshig tu 'gyur//zhes pa ste/ ming gang yang rung ba'i mtha' na mtha' de dang mthun pa ste/ mtha' der 'os shing skabs su babs pa yi rjes 'jug bzhi pa na yis/ la i sbyar bas/ ni zhes grub pa de ni gzhi de las mchog tu dgar ba'am/ mchog ma yin pa dgar ba'am/ tha dad tsam du dmigs su bzung nas dgar ba dang / don gang yin de yang nas yang du nan tan gyis brjod pa ni brnan pa zhes bya ste/ de gnyis la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad du 'gyur ro//de yang dgar gzhi rigs mthun pa las dgar ba ni/ dper na/ 'dod lha'i gnas rnams las dga' ldan ni mchog go /lha'i nang nas brgya byin ni mig stong dang ldan no lta bu dang / rigs mi mthun pa las dgar ba ni/sangs rgyas ni nyan rang las mchog go /lha ni mi las mdzes so lta bu dang /dmigs kyis dgar ba ni/ gdong bzhi pa 'di ni tshangs pa'o/ /'jug pa bcu dang ldan pa ni khyab 'jug go lta bu dang / gzhan yang sha mong ni 'brug grags pa'i tshe skye'o/ /lug thug gi rwa ni pha lam gyis mi chod do lta bu rnams so/ /brnan pa la 'jug pa ni/ gzhan gyi zla la ma ltos par ngo bo dang khyad par bya byed sogs rang sa rang sar lhag par nges pa'am nan tan du nges par byed pa ste/ dper na bcas ldan dge slong gis lhag po min pa'i yo

46byad 'chod chas bcu gsum grangs bsher byed pa na/ snam sbyar dang chodas gos ni sku/da/ mthang bo sa dang / sham thabs dang / sham thabs kyi gzan ni yod/ rngul gzan dang rngul gzan gyi gzan ni yod/ gdong phyis dang /rnag gzan dang / g.yan pa dgab pa ni yod / skra gzed dang / gding ba dang / dbyar gyi gos ras chen ni yod ces re re nas nges nges byed pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dzadas thams cad ni thugs su chud/ spang bar bya ba ni spangs / chub par bya ba ni chub/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni bskor/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni bsgrengs/ chos kyi dung ni bus/ slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas pa ni mnga' lta bu dang / 'jig rten na su ni dar/ su ni rgud/ su ni dge ba la spyod sogs mdo las byung ba lta bu dang / khyod ni bla ma khyod ni yi dam lta bu dang / sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad kha skong gi ni sgra yang nges bzung gi brnan pa'i sgra nyid du gsungs so//gnyis pa dang sgra 'byed sdud sogs bshad pa ni/ming gang yang rung ba'i bar ma tshams su//gsum pa la ni gnyis pa sbyar//de ni sdud dang 'byed pa dang //rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga'o//

47zhes pa ste/ ming gang yang rung ba tshogs pa'i bar skabs su rjes 'jug gi yi ge gsum pa da yig la gnyis pa nga yig sbyar bas/ dang zhes grub pa de ni/ ming tshig snga phyi phyogs gcig tu sdud pa dang / de dag sa/ sor 'byed pa dang / rgyu de ruras mtshan ma de byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi don dang / dus blta da pa'i tshe skabs dang / gzhan la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i gdams ngag ste lnga la 'jug go /de'ang sdud pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na / 'dus byas nga/nga 'dus ma byas ni chodas mo lta bu bsdu bya gnyis chos gcig tu bsdus pa dang / don la dmigs pa dang / sgra las byung ba dang / mthun par snang ba dang / thun mang la grags pa dang / mngan par zhen pa ni brnga yi khyad chos lnga'o lta bu chos lnga po de khyad gzhi brda'i don gcig tu bsdus pa dang / bum pa mi rtag go /ka ba dang / snam bu yang ngo lta bu snga mar sbyar ba'i chos mi rtag pa phyi ma ra yang sbyor ba sdud pa dang /bum pa dang / ka ba dang / snam bu yang bdag med do lta bu phyi mar sbyar ba'i chos bdag me da pa snga mar sbyor ba sdud pa sogs snga phyi sdud pa'o/ /'byed pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ yi ge 'jug pa'i grenas ni brgyad de/ sgra dang / skad dang / ming dang / mtshan ma dang / brda dang /tha snya da dang / tshig dang / don rnams so/ /lta bu dbye gzhi gcig las rnam grangs du mar 'byed pa ste/ gam la sogs pa bzhin sdud/ /mdor na

48chos spyor ba snga phyi sdud pa dang / ngo bo so sor bgrangs nas phyogs gcig tu sdud pa ste sdud pa gnyis dang / gzhi gcig rnam grangs tha dad par 'byed pa dang bcas pa'i khyad par te 'byed pa tsam dang / phye nas phyogs gcig tu byed pa'am khyad par gcig tu sbyor bso// /rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa ni/gtan tshigs ston pa ste/ legs par bslab dang mkhas par 'gyur mo / /byas pa dang mi rtag sman zos pa dang nad sos/ dzadas mang du thos pa dang lhag mthong 'phel/ du ba mthong ba dang mer shes lta bu'o/ /tshe skabs la 'jug pa ni dus ston pa ste/ skar ma ri ṣi shar ba dang khrus bya/nyi ma shar ba dang chos ston/ nam langs pa dang 'gro de skad ces bka' stsal ba dang lta bu'o/ /gdams ngag la 'jug pa ni/ ngag gi sgo nas gzhan la bya ba'i thabs slob pa dang / bskul ba'i phyir brjod pa ste/ 'di ltar gyis dang / legs par nyon dang / slob dang / sgom dang / yid la zungs dang / mi dge ba spongs dang lta bu dang / yang tshe'i tshig phrad rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa'ang yod cing / gzhan yang rgyu yod na 'bras bu 'byung /rgyu yod pa las 'bras bu 'byung / rgyu yod pa dang 'bras bu 'byung lta bu la / rgyu yod pa'i tshe 'bras bu 'byung bya ba yin pas dus dang rgyu mtshan lhan cig tu ston pa'ang yod do/ /gsum pa de sgra tha snyad sogs don dgu la 'jug tshul bshad pa ni/

49gang ming gi ni ya mtha' ru//gsum pa la ni e sbyar ba//tha snyad dbang du gsum yin te//dngos po'i dbang gis bzhi ru 'gyur//dus kyi dbang gis gnyis yin no//zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming gi mtha' ste thog ma ru rjes 'jug yi ge gsum pa da yig la dbyangs gsum pa e sbyar bas/ de zhes grub pa de ni don dgu la 'jug pa ste/ tha snyad kyi dbang du 'jug pa gsum yin te/ dngos po'i dbang gis 'jug pa bzhi ru 'gyur ba dang / dus kyi dbang gis 'jug pa gnyis bcas yin no/ /de yang brda dang / tha snyad ces pa'i don yang sa paṇa gyis/ming tshig de dag rgan po yis//sgyu ga mar sbyar ba brda yin la//phyis nas daspyadad pa tha snyad yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dngos po rnams kyi ming du rgan po rnams kyis brjod 'dod kyis btags pa'i brda la 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming zhes bya zhing / phyi nas ming de la brten nas 'dra ba dang 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas sgro 'aro/gas kyis btags pa ni tha snyad rjes grub kyi ming zhes bya
