192dang / med dgag bcu gcig bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gdams ngag brjod pas mjug bsdu ba la gnyis/ tshig bcad 'grol ba'i man ngag bshad pa dang / rjes 'jug la slob tshul sogs kyi go rim bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ rjes 'jug gi sbyor ba la slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang /bslab nas ji ltar bya ba/ mkhas par bya ba'i thabs bstan pa/ slar yang don bsdus te gdams pa/ gzhung 'di nyid snod rung gi gang zag la 'doms dgos par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis rgyu mtshan de dag med du mi rung bstan pa dang / rgyu mtshan dasngags bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcos brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba bsngo ba dang / rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa tha mar dge ba mjug gi don bcas so// /gnyis pa/ rtags 'jug gi sa bcad ni/ bod gangs can gyi skad kyis sgra'i mtshan nyid lung du ston pa'i gtsug lag gi gzhung rtags kyi 'jug pa'i don mdo tsam bshad pa la gsum/ klad kyi don dang /gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan don dang /'gyur phyag go/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa/mjug gi dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mchod brjod dang brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos bshad pa la gsum/ sde

193tshan lnga ru dril te ming gzhi'i yi ge spyi'i rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang /sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa la gsum/ming gzhi'i mo yig gi nang nas sngon rjes dbyung tshul bshad pa dang / sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ gang la 'jug pa dang / gang gis 'jug pa thun mong du bshad pa dang / ji ltar 'jug pa bshad pa/ ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thun mong du 'jug tshul rgyas par bshad pa dang / zhar byung mi 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa/rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa la gnyis/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang / rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyir rtags gsum du dbye ba dang / nang gses brgyad du dbye ba'o/ /gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ gang la 'jug pa/ gang gis 'jug pa/ ji ltar 'jug pa/ ci phyir 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /gaskum pa ji ltar 'jug pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la

194gnyis/ sgra'i 'jug tshul bshad pa dang / don gyi 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sgra drag zhan spyir 'jug tshul bshad pa dang / nang gses zhib tu 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pacod/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa dang / phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ ming mtha' 'dren tshul bshad pa dang / rnam dbye sogs 'dren tshul bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis/spyir 'dren tshul bshad pa dang / nang gses 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rnam dbye'i nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa dang / phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa bshad pacod/ /bzhi pa ci phyir 'jug pa bshad pa la gnyis/ rjes 'jug gi dgos pa dngos bshad pa dang / zhar byung yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i dgos pa bshad paso// /gnyis pa la gnyis/ yi ge'i 'jug pa rnams kyi rang bzhin gyi dgos pa bshad pa dang / yi ge'i 'jug pa ston pa'i bstan bcos 'di nyid brtsams pa'i dgos pa dpes bstan pa'i lha nas don bsdus pa'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcodas brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba bsngo ba dang / rtsa ba'i sa bcadace gsum pa mjug gi don bcas so// // sto

195lnga pa/rigashi/ /yi ge ming tshig gi tshul mdo tsam bsnyu da pa zhar byung dang bcas pa rig lam snang byed ces bya ba bsdo/gas sa//༈ na mo gu ru ya/ smra ba'i nyi ma nyi ma'i gnyen la sogs/ /smra mchog mtshungs med dza gas la gus btud nas/ /smra ba'i yan lag yi ge ming tshig chogs/ /smra la dbang phyir dbang po'i yul du 'god/ /byang grol dri med rnam dag bsrub pa'i lam/ /legs 'dodam lung gi bstan pa yi ge yis/ /'dzin slad bachod sprul rang bzhin rigs lam gyi/ /gtsug lag la 'jug tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i rgyu/ /de yang shes bya sgra tshad bzo gso dang / /nang don sde snod rig gnas che ba ci / /snyan ngag sdeb spyor mngon brjod zlos gar dang / /skar rtsis 'di lnga rig gnas chung ba ste/ /de dag

196kun gyi rtsa ba yi ge nyid/ /de phyir thog mar yi ge mkhas par sbyangs/ /yi ge zhes bya sgra dang gzugs gnyis las/ /sgra ni rgyu mthun rgyas byung bzhis bskyed cing / /gzugs ni ka sogs bri bya'i ri mo rnams/ /brda dang tha snyad shes brjod 'jug las rtogs/ /de la yi ge'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ /ming tshig rtsom gzhi'i skad kyi gdangs nyid de/ /de nyid kun slong shes pa las skyes sgra'i/ /yi ge mig 'dzum tshad kyi ring thung dang / /cha shas skad cig re re 'dus pa'i rgyun/ /ldan min 'du byed nyid du bye mdo bzhed/ /yi ge'i sgra don nges tshig ji ltar na/ /'gyur med ming tshig gsal dang brjod byed do/ /de la yi ge'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ /don mi ston pa'i sgra spyi snang ba'o/ /mtshan gzhi a sogs dbyangs gsal gzugs rnams te/ /sgra yi (sprujug yul yi ge ji snyed do/ /yig rigs sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi las/ /'phags yul yi ge lnga bcu'i lanya war las/ /lo chen thodan mis bsgyur ba'i bod yig la/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid lung du lton byed kyi/ /rtsa ba'i yi ge sum bcu tham pa'o/ /de la dbye na dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis/ /sgra yi nga ro tsam la dbyangs zhes bya/ /brjod bya gsal bar byed phyir gsal byed do/ /de yi sngon rjes ming gzhi mgo 'dogs dbyangs/ /srog rkyen pha ma bu yig rtags gsum sogs/ /dbye ba'i rnam grangs chig khri bdun stong dang / /lnga brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis grangs su 'gro/ /bod yig dbyangs

197kyi nga ro lnga yin te/ /a i ༷/ e a rnams rim pa bzhin/ /drang po bkug smad bsgreng dang bstod pa'o/ /nga ro'i rtsa ba a ha 'a gsum ste/ /de las pho mo ma ning 'byung ba'i tshul/ /a sgra mgrin dam dbugs chung sgra drag pas/ /pho yig ka ca ta pa tsa rnams 'byung / /ha sgra khog pa cung glod dbugs che bas/ /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha rnams 'byung / /'a sgra mgrin pa glod de dbugs zhan pas/ /mo yig ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ /za ya ra la sha sa rnams 'byung zhing / /nang gses byed pa dam lhod dbye ba dang / /mo gsham la sogs mo yig khongs nas dbye/ /'a sgra sna nas/ 'don la sna ldan zhes/ /shin tu mo yig nga nya na ma'o/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga las pho yig ba 1 1 ma ning ga da gnyis dang mo yig 'a/ /shin tu mo yi yi ge ma yig go /rjes 'jug bcu las da ba sa gsum pho/ /'a ni ma ning ga ra la gsum mo/ /nga na ma gsum shin tu mo yin no/ /'di la mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mang mchis pas/ /'dir ni bra ti paṇa chen lugs bzhin no/ /bod yig lci yang tha snyad ma mchis kyang / /snyan ngag rjes khrid rgyan la 'jam rtsub kyi/ /dbye ba'i tha snyad mdzad pa 'di lta ste/ /ka ca ta pa tsa dang ga ja da/ /ba dza nga nya na ma wa 'a ya/ /ra la a ste yi ge nyi shu ni/ /'jam pa yang ba srog chung lto da pa dang / /mnyen pa yi ge mchog rnams rnam grangs so/ /kha cha tha pha tsha dang zha za sha/ /sa ha yi ge bcu ni rtsub pa dang / /lci

198ba srog chen dam pa gyong ba dang / /yi ge dman pa zhes bya rnam grangs so/ /dbyangs yig a i ༷/ e o lnga rnams/ /sku ga chen yi ge nyid du bzhed pa'ang sku da/ /yi ge gang las skye ba'i rgyu bzhi ste/ /gnas dang byed pa rlung dang rnam rtog go /khog mgrin rkan so lce mchu spyi bo dang / /sna rnams yi ge'i 'byung gnas gzhi yi rgyu/ /phrad dang cung phrad phye btsum yang dog gi /byed pa drug ni 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu/ /rlung gi g.yo ba'i rtsol ba skyed byed rgyu/ /rnam lta ga kun slong rtsol ba skul byed rgyu/ /rtsol ba gnyis ni 'jug pa gcig pacad/ /sgra skad ming dang mtshan ma brda tha snyad/ /tshig don yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad de/ /de dag so so'i sgra don 'dres 'dzin klor/ /don la dmigs dang sgra las byung ba dang / /mthun par snang dang thun mong grags pa dang / /mngon par zhen pa brda yi khyad dzadas lnga'o/ /brda sgod sgra yi brjod bya'i gtso bo ni/ /tshig gi rnam dbye tshig bsdu la sogs te/ /de la rnam dbye zhes bya'i sgra don ni/ /don ldog ston pa rnam dbye'i mtshan nyid de/ /dodan dang tshig kun rnam par dbye bas so/ /phye na ngo bo las sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /gcig tshig la sku/gas ga3/ma ga3/ma dbye ba dang / /byed pa drug la sgyur dang bsdu ba ldan/ /de las rnam dbye dang po gang zhe na/ /chos rnams so so'i ming gi ngo bo tsam/ /brjod pa rnam dbye dang po'i gnas yin te/ /de la'ang ming dang ming rkyang gnyis yod pa'i/

199/ming rkyang rnams ni rnam dbye dang watwarngo/ /don gyi ngo bo tsam zhig ston pa yi/ /sgra spyi snang ba ming gi mtshan nyid de/ /mtshan gzhi sangs rgyas dzadas dang dge 'dun dang / /ka ba bum pa la sogs ji snyed pa'o/ /dbye na 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming dang ni/ /rjes grub btags pa'i ming gnyis yod pa las/ /dang wa 'dodad rgyal rgyu mtshan gzhi gzhan la/ /ma lha sa rang gar brda la nges tshig med/ /rjes grub ming la don ldan rjes grub dang / /log par sgrub pa'i rjes grub gnyis yod de/ /gzhan la ltos nas yang dag sgrub pa dang / /log par sgrub pa gnyis te dang po la/ /dngos ming gsum dang btags ming lnga la sogs/ /'dra 'brel rgyu mtshan hre gas cha sna dza gas pa'i/ /rnam grangs mngon bakhyodad ming ni mtha' yas te/ /ming gcig don mang nge na gcig ming mang gi /khams la mkhas na ming la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /ming gnyis 'dus pa'am mang po 'dus kyang rung / /don gyi khyad par gsal bar byed pa yi/ /sgra spyi snang ba tshig gi mtshan nyid de/ /rnam dbye'i gnas rnams gsal bar byed pa'i sgra'o/ /de la bya byed las dang bdag gzhan dus/ /shes par bya ste de yang byed pa pos/ /bya ba bsgrub par bya ba'i yul de la/ /las kyi dngos po zhes su grags pa ste/ /las dang bya yul don gcig shes bya zhing / /byed pa po la gtso bo phal ba gnyis/ /las la bya ba'i las dang byed pa'i las/ /bya ba'ang dus 'das

200da lta ma 'ongs gsum/ /byed pa po dang de yi byed pa gnyis/ /dngos po bdag yin bya ba'i yul dang ni/ /de yi bya ba gnyis ni dngos po gzhan/ /de yang bya byed rdzas gzhan rdzas gcig gi /dbye bas mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba'i/ /'khor gsum 'jog tshul rnam pa sa/nyis su gsungs/ /rnam dbye dang po ming la slar bsdu sogs/ /sbyar bas tshig 'grub tshig la rnam dbye dang / /tshig sdud tshig phrad tshig rgyan la se gas kyi/ /sgra rnams shes na don la mkhas zhes gsungs/ /ngo bo chos gcig kho na'ang tshig nge na gyi/ /dbang gis rnam dbye so so'i gnas 'gyur te/ /dper na chos la spyod ces brjod pa na/ /bya yul gsal bar ston phyir gnyis pa'i sgra/ /chos kyis tshim par byed ces lta bu ni/ /gzhan 'brel byed pa gsal phyir gsum pa'i sgra/ /chos kyi phyir du dka' ba spyod lta bu/ /dgos pa gtso bor ston phyir bzhi pa'i sgra/ /chos las dge tshogs kun 'byung lta bu ni/ /gang las byung ba'i gnas ston lnga pa'i sgra/ /chos kyi yon tan lta bu khyad gzhi dang / /khyad chos 'brel bar lha na phyir drug pa'i sgra/ /chos la gnas sori lta bu rten brten pa'i/ /khyad par gsal byed rnam dbye bdun pa'i sgra/ /kye kye chos ni bdud rtsi'i mchog lta bu/ /bod pa gsal byed rnam dbye brgyad pa'o/ /'dus ma byas kyi chos su grub lta bu/ /rnam dbye gnyis pa'i bye brag de nyid dang / /chos la goms na bde ba thob lta bu/ /dus la sbyor

201pa'i bdun pa tshe skabs so/ /sngon 'jug rtags kyi ming gzhir 'jug tshul las/ /pho yig dus 'das dngos po gzhan bsgrub dang / /ma ning bdag gzhan gnyis dang dus da lta/ /mo yig bdag dang da lta ma 'ongs dus/ /shin tu mo yig kun la cha mnyam 'jug /de bzhin rjes 'jug rtags gsum drag zhan dang / /ming mtha' rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul sgra dang don/ /ci phyir 'jug sogs tshul bzhin shes par bya/ ༈ོ /de ltar gzhi mtha'i yi ge la ltos pa'i/ /phrad dang rnam dbye gsal byed gzhi mthun sgra/ /tshig rnams 'brel bar byed cing bar gyi tshig /gsal byed bsdus la tshig sdud ces bya'o/ /tshig gi sbyor ba bsdu na bcu yin te/ /'bru mang po dang tshig sdud khyad par bsdu/ /yan lag bsdu dang gzhi bsdu gzhi gcig bsdu/ /gzhi mthun bsdu ba dang ni de'i skyes bu/ /zlas dbye'i bsngu ba phyogs tsam stodan pa'o/ /dang po 'byu mang po la dbye na drug /tshig gnyis dang ni tshig mang dbye ba yi/ /rang ming ldan dang mi ldan phyogs tsam dang / /rnam grangs phan tshun tshig mang po ste drug /de dag gzhi mthun pa yi 'bru mang dang / /gzhi tha dad pa'i dbye bas mu bzhir 'gyur/ /de dag so sor rnam dbye gnyis pa nas/ /bdun pa'i bar gyi byed pa tshig drug gis/ /bsgyur dang dang po'i tshig bcas bdun bdun du/ /dbye ba rnam grangs brgya dang drug cu brgyad/ /kun la khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshig

202bsdu ba'ang lnga yodad de/ /tshig gnyis dag gi mdor bsdus zlas dbye dang / /rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa yi ba gnyis pa/ /bye brag mdor bsdus las 'dzin bsdus pa dang / /gzhan tshig mdor bsdus 'byu mang po zhes dang / /byed pa'i tshig gi mdor bsdus de'i skyes bu/ /rnam dbye drug gi gsal byed bsdus pa la/ /byed pa'i tshig gi bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa khyad par bsdu ba gnyis yin te/ /snga ma phyi ma'i khyad par sbyor ba'o/ /bzhi pa yan lag bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi/ /'brel ba'i yan lag bo rim yan lag dang / /don gyi yan lag grags pa'i yan lag ste/ /phyi mar 'jig rten bstan bcos la grags gnyis/ /lnga pa gzhi ba3ci ba la gnyis yod de/ /rigs gsal byas dang ma byas khyad par ro/ /drug pa gzhi gcig bsdu ba'ang phyogs gcig tu/ /byed dang se so phyo gas gnyis byed pas gnyis/ /bdun pa gzhi mthun bsdu ba'ang khyad par dang/ /khyad par can gnyis gzhi gcig la phyu ra gnyis/ /chos gang tha dad pa dag gzhi gcig par/ /go ba'i sgra spyor gzhi mthun bsdu ba'o/ /brgyad pa de yi skyes bu'i bsdu ba la/ /byed pa'i tshig dang las 'dzin ba gnyis kyi/ /bsdu ba gsum ste ngo bo'am de yi chos/ /tha dad sbyor ba'i skabs ni de'i skyes bu'o/ /dang po ced pa'i tshig gi de'i skyes bur/ /rnam dbye bsgyur ba bdun dang dgag pa bcas/ /brgyad du dbye zhing dgag pa nyid la yang / /ma yin dgag

203dang med dgag gnyis su dbye/ /dang po chos gang mtshan nyid mi mthun pa'i/ /dbang gis ma yin dgag pa bcu bzhi ste/ /gzhan dang mi mthun gnyen po chung dang phra/ /nyung dang yun thung lhag ma med pa dang / /mtha' dag min dang bral ba dman pa dang / /zhan dang zhum pa 'dra bar dgag pa'o/ /chos gzhan dgag pa'i sgo nas rang nyid kyi/ /ngo bo ston pa ma yin dgag ces bya/ /gnyis pa med dgag la yang yul dus kyis/ /phye bas rnam grangs brgyad gsum bcu gcig ste/ /rgyun dang rang bzhin skabs dang rten bzhi yin/ /dbye bas snga nas med pa bzhi dang ni/ /zhig nas med par dgag pa bzhi ste brgyad/ /chodas gang phan tshun gcig la gcig med dang / /rgyu dang rang bzhi shin tu med gsum mo/ /de la dgag pa'i nges tshig gang zhe na/ /kun tu ldog phyir dgag pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan sel la ni dgag sgrub gnyis yod de/ /dgag la ma yin dgag dang med dgag gnyis/ /sgrub pa sku da dang yin la sogs pa ste/ /sgrub par 'brel ba dag ni ma yin dgag /sgrub par ma 'brel ba ni med dgag go /gnyis pa las 'dzin pa yis de'i skyes bur/ /gzhan du brjod med 'dra ba bye brag gi /tshig sbyor gsum ste tre/ dag gzhi gcig gi /chos su sbyor bar mtshungs pas las 'dzin no/ /gsum pa ba gnyis pa yi de'i skyes bur/ /grangs kyi tshig dang bsdus pa'i tshig sbyor la/ /gcig gi tshig gis gcig tu ston pa dang / /mang

204po'i tshig gis tha dad ston pa gnyis/ /de yang bsdu ba yod pa'i ba dang ni/ /rnam grangs yod pa'i ba ste ba gnyis pa'o/ /dgu pa zlas dbye ba yi tshig bsdu la/ /bsdu ba dang ni dbye phyir sbyor ba dang / /'das ma thag pa'i sgra dang gzhan sdud dang / /lan grangs gzhan la sbyor ba'i tshig sdud pacod/ /zlas dbye ba zhes bya ba'i sgra don yang / /zlas dang dbye bas gnyis par ston pa'o/ /bcu pa phyogs tsam ston pa'i tshig sdud ni/ /rang gi rigs tsam sdud cing phyogs gzhan spong / /rigs kyi tshad kyang 'dzin par mi byed pa / / de la phyogs tsam ston pa zhes bya'o/ /tshig sdud de rnams bsdu na las 'dzin dang / /ba gnyis pa yi bsdu ba de'i skyes bu/ /'bru mang po dang zlas dbye mi zad pa'i/ /bsdu ba drug tu bsdus te bshad pa'ang yod/ ༈ /tshig phrad gang su ci ji kho na tsam/ /ste de 'o na ma mi ni la sogs/ /rang nyid rkyang pas don gzhan mi mchosan cing / /ming tshig gzhan dang phrad na don ston phyir/ /tshig phrad ces bya ming tshig 'brel bar byed/ /gang ni spyi sgra 'dri ba'i tshig yin te/ /zla sdud ma gtogs kun la 'jug par byed/ /su sgra gang zag la 'jug spyi sgra'o/ /de sgra tha snyad 'das sogs don dgur 'jug /dngos po bdag dang da lta'i dus la spang / /'di tshig nye dang mngon sum da ltar 'jug /lkog dang ring ba dus 'das ma 'ongs spang / /de ltar gang dang de dang 'di sgra gsum/ /rnam dbye bsgyur ba don

205ldan shes par bya/ /da ni 'das pa'i dus la mi 'jug go /na sgra dmigs kyis 'byed dang rgyu mtshan dang / /rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan dang las dang ched/ /rten gnas phyi tshig de gzhan sogs rnyedan dang / /mi 'os tshig gis phyi ma nges byed dang / /snga ma'i tshig gis phyi ma nges byed dang / /'gal ba'ang mi 'gal ston dang smon dang 'dri/ /the tshom tshe skabs de nyid rnams la 'jug /ste ni lhag ma 'dren pa'i sgra yin te/ /mtshams sbyor dam bca' gzhan 'dren gsum la 'jug /dang gi sgra ni 'byed sdud rgyu mtshan dang / /tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga la 'jug pa'o/ /ni sgra dgar bsnan gnyis kyis dang po la/ /bkod pa dang ni zla las dgar ba gnyis/ /brnan pa'ang ngo bo nyid dang rnam grangs gnyis/ /kyang sogs tshig rgyan gnyis dang sdud pa dang / /rnam par brtag pa nges bzung smod pa dang / /dri ba dogs pa srid pa rnams la 'jug /kho na zhes bya'i sgra ni bcad tshig ste/ /gzhan mi ldan pa nges par bzung ba dang / /gzhan la mi ldan nges par bzung ba dang / /de las ldog pa'i ma nges rnam pa gnyis/ /ldan pa tsam dang mi slu ba dang drug /nyid kyi sgra yang de dang 'dra ba las/ /phyi tshig tha dad min par ston pa dang / /dngos po'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'i khyad par ro/ /tsam ni tshad 'dzin lhag ma 'gog pa ste/ /'ba' zhig sha stag dag kyang de mtshungs shing / /nges bzung don dang mi slu mang tshig go /yang dag yongs su kun

206tu shin tu sogs/ /don gzhan mi lha na phrad dang rgyan tsam mo/ /dzaXl gyi sgra ni 'dra dang smad pa dang / /sgo dang sdom pa mtshan nyid thabs rigs pa / / don dang 'dod pa legs pa bcu la 'jug /bzhin dang ltar dang lta bu la sogs ni/ /ma nor ba dang yin pa 'dra ba sku gas/ /mtshungs gsal dpe rgyan rnams la 'jug pa'o/ /cing zhing shing sogs sdud dang mtshams sbyor gyi/ /lhag bcas ste sogs don dang mthun par 'jug /la sgra rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / /sdud dang sbyor ba smon dang tshad 'dzin dang / /gzhi dang de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug /kyi sogs phan tshun 'brel ba ston pa'i gnas/ /kyis sogs byed pa ston pa'i rnam dbye ste/ /la don byed sgra 'brel sgra gsum ka la/ /mi mthun pa yi rgyan la 'jug pa'ang yod/ /nas las 'byung khungs dgar dang sdud pa'i sgra/ /mtshams sbyor lhag bcas phrad la nas sgra lhag /su ra ru du na la tu rnams ni/ /la dang mthun zhing gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / /de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug pa'o/ /'o na phyogs gcig khong du chud pa las/ /phyogs gcig 'dri bar byed pa'i tshig phrad do/ /gam/ ngam/ dam sogs 'byed dang sdud pa'i sgra'o/ /dag dang rnams ni nyis tshig ma/nga tshig dang / /sogs ni mtha' dag sdud par byed pa'i sgra/ /tshe ni skabs 'gar rgyu mtshan la 'jug cing //cha ni dus tshigs bzung ba la yang 'jug /'u ni chung ngu'am dman pa'i

207don la ste/ /gu ni smon pa'i don du 'jug pa yin/ /de yang zhes bya nye bar bstan pa'i tshig /lo grag zer ni ma rangs zur za'i sgra/ /ma lus cog dang mtha' dag mang tshig ste/ /yongs su sdud pa'i don la'ang 'jug pa'o/ /gzhan yang dang yig ra sgrar 'gyur ba dang / /dkon cog rin can la sogs brda rnying sgra /rgyal mtshan bsdus la rgyan dang rgya mchosar rgyam/ /bkra shis bsdus la bkras dang cho gar dzadag /rab 'byams rams sogs phyis kyi tha snyad mang / /nge ltar tshig phrad rnam grangs mdor bsdu na / / na la su sogs rang dbang can gyi phrad/ /kyi gyi gi sogs gzhan dbang can gyi phrad/ /bsdoms pas phrad rkyang brgyad cu'i grangs su 'gro/phrad dang rnam dbye gzhi mthun mu bzhi dang / /phrad rnams 'dus pas don gzhan ston pa'i tshig /'di ltar gang tshe de ste sogs gnyis 'dus/ /de ste na dang gang gi tshe na sogs/ /gsum 'dus bzhi 'dus lnga drug 'dus pa'ang yod/ /de ltar rnam dbye tshig bsdu tshig phrad rnams/ /legs par rtogs nas tshig rgyan tshul la 'jug ༈ /de yang tshig rgyan zhes bya gang zhes na/ /tshig phrad 'ga' zhig rgyan du 'gyur pa ya nga / /yod mod gtso bo grong tshig spong ched du/ /bstan bcos la grags don bzang tshig mdzes kyi/ /rgyan la tshig rgyan zhes bya snyan ngag ste/ /snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mkhas zhes/ /gsungs bzhin daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung don rgya gar gyi/ /lho shar

208mkhas pa'i bzhed srol thun mong rgyan/ /le'u dang po'i dngos bstan tshig rirgyan ni/ /sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid snyan pa dang / /shin tu gzhon pa don gsal rgya che ba/ /brjid mdzes ting nge 'dzin dang bcu rnams so/ /le'u gnyis par don rgyan so lnga ste/ /dang po rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan zhes pa / / rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas bzhi yi/ /ngo bo rang bzhin gsal par brjod pa'i rgyan/ /gnyis pa dpe rgyan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /mtshungs pa gsal byed tshig rgyan bdun cubo / /gsum pa gzugs can rgyan ni nyi shu dang / /de bzhin gsal byed rgyan dang bskor pa'i rgyan/ /'gog pa'i rgyan dang dodan gzhan bskadad pa'i rgyan/ /ldog pa can dang srid pa can gyi rgyan/ /bsdus brjod phul byung rab btags rgyu yi rgyan/ /phra shārware rgyan dang cha rgyan rim pa can/ /dga' rgyan nyams ldan gzi brjid can gyi rgyan/ /rnam grangs brdzod dang kun phan rgya che'i rgyan/ /snyon dor spyor ba khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ /mtshungs sbyor mdzes rgyan skabs min balha da pa'i rgyan/ /zol bstod nges bstan lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan/ /yongs brjes shis pa'i rgyan dang rab spel rgyan/ /dgongs pa can gyi rgyan dang so lnga ste/ /re rer rnam grangs du ma'i tshig rgyan gyi/ /nang gses dbye ba brgya phrag gnyis sku da do/ /le'u gsum par sgra rgyan gab tshig rgyan/ /skyon sel gsum ste dang lnga sgra rgyan la/ /bya dka'i

209rgyan gsum zung ldan rgyan bco lnga/ /gam tshig rgyan la rnam grangs bcu drug dang / /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten lung rigs sogs/ /'gal ba'i skyon bcu spong tshul bcas bsdoms pas/ /bzhi cu zhe bzhi'o 'di dag tshul bzhin du/ /shes la snyan ngag smra ba zhes bya ste/ /sa steng rin chen gsum gyi ya gyal yin/ /snyan ngag lus la bcad lhug spel ma gsum/ /sbyor tshul dbang gis hrol rigs mdzod 'dus bzhi/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba dgod sogs nyams 'gyur brgyad/ ༈ de yang tshigs bcad rkang bzhi la sogs la/ /nges par dgos pa'i sdeb sbyor rig pa ni/ /tshigs bcad sdeb sbyor yi ge drug pa nas/ /rgyun chags bar du bgrang ba bṛ ṣā ste/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam phyed mnyam gsum gyis bcing / /rkang bzhi so sor yi ge'i grangs lci yang / /mtshan nyid mtshungs pa mnyam pa'i bṛ t+yādang / /de las ldog pa mi mnyam bṛ t+yā ste/ /'dres pa dag la phyed mnyam zhes bya'o/ /dbyangs gsal lci yang phyi mo 'god tshul dang / /rkang bzhi mnyam dang mi mnyam phyed mnyam gyis/ /dzā ti 'phags ma zod langs dmar ser gsum/ /khyad par mthun mo nga rtogs byed la se gas pa / / yon tan brgyad ldan gzhung don mthar phyin na/ /tshigs su bcad la mi rmongs mkhas par 'gyur/ /'di nyid legs sbyar sgra yi dbang du ste/ /tshig gi 'khrul pa tshar gcod sgra rig pa / / de yang rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum/ /brda sprod gzhung

210gi brjod bya yin zhes gsungs/ /dang po rang bzhin byings dang ming gi byings/ /rang bzhin byings la yongs su bklags sogs drug /ming gi rang bzhin rtags gsum dbye ba las/ /dag pa 'dres pa gtibs pa'i rtags sogs drug /gnyis pa rkyen ni byings nyid byings sgrub dang / /byings las tshig sgru4 ming sgrub la tro/gas bdun/ /byings las rkyen gyis sgrub pa'i sgra la yang / /rigs dang bya ba yon tan ngo bo bzhi/ /de dgo byed dngos las su 'du bar gaskungs/ /gsum pa rnam 'aglur dngas dang bsdu ba gnyis/ /dang por ngo bo de yi dbye ba mang / /don dang rnam pa nye sgyur nyi shu dang / /yan lag rnam 'gyur a gā ma yi rkyen/ /phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur yi ge rkyen sogs gsum/ /rnam 'gyur gnyis pa tshig gi bsdu ba la/ /las 'dzin ba gnyis la sogs spyir drug dang/ /dbye ba nyer brgyad ngo bo mdor bsdu na/ /ming tshig rnam 'gyur gsum du 'du ba'o/ /sgra shes don la rmongs par mi 'aglur zhe sa/ /tshig don ma nor bde glag rtogs par 'gyur/ ༈ོ /don la 'khrul ba tshar gcod tshad ma ni/ /rtsa ba yul dang yul can rtogs byed gsum/ /yul la dbye na dngos po dngos med dang / /'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang rtag mi rtag /dang po dngos ngo ra ngo bo bem rig gnyis/ /bem po'ang phyi don nang don bem po gnyis/ /phyi don bem po gzugs sgra dri ro reg /nang don bem po mig rna sna lce

211lus/ /dngo sa por byed pas dbye na rgyu 'bras gnyis/ /rgyu la dngos kyi rgyu dang brgyud rgyu gnyis/ /yul la gzung yul zhem/ yul 'jug yul gsum/ /gzhal bya sku)gas dzaXl rang mtshan spyi mtshan gnyis/ /yang na mngon gyur lkog gyur shin lkog gsum/ /gnyis pa yul can rjod byed shes pa gnyis/ /rjod byed ngo bo'i sgo nas ming tshig ngag /brjod bya'i sgo nas rigs brjod tshogs brdzod gnyis/ /rjod tshul dbang gis chodas brjod chodas can brjod/ /rjod byed rnam gcod dbang gis dbye ba gsum/ /mi ldan gzhan ldan mi srid rnam gcod do/ /rjod byed 'chad dus sgo nas dbye ba ni/ /zhen pa'i rjod byed dngos kyi rjod byed gnyis/ /snga mar dngos dang shugs kyi zhen rjod gnyis/ /de bzhin yi ge gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ /blo rig shes gsum don gcig de dbye na/ /tshad ma tshad min rtog pa rtog med dang / /'khrul dang ma 'khrul rang rig gzhan rig dang / /sems dang sems byung dang bcas bcu nyid do/ /sems la dbye na rnam shes tshogs drug dang / /sems byung dbye ba lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga dang ni/ /rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu dang / /dge ba bcu gcig gzhan 'gyur bzhi rnams so/ /tshad mar mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis dang por/ /dbang yid rang rig rnal 'gyor mingon gsum bzhi/ /rjes dpag tshul gsum rtags las dalnga sa stobs dang / /grags

212pa yid ches rjes dpag rnam gsum mo/ /gsum pa rtogs byed 'gal 'brel dgag sgrub dang / /spyi dang bye brag gcig dang tha dad dang / /sel 'jug sgrub 'jug gzhan sel mtshan mchodan dang / /rdzas chodas ldog chos rjes dpag rnam gnyis sogs/ /rang don rjes dpag dbye na phyogs chodas dang / /rjes khyab ldog khyab tshul gsum nges pa'i rtags/ /gzhan nge na rjes dpag rgol gnyis mthun grub kyi/ /tshul gsum sgub ngag yan lag gnyis ldan dang / /rtags gsal sun 'byin thal 'gyur la sogs pa/ /ltar snang dor nas yang dag nyid kyis bsgrub/ /tshad ma'i brjod bya bsdu na mngon gsum dang / /rjes dpag yang dag ltar snang bdag rig bzhi/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin yang dag ltar snang bzhi/ /gzhan la go byed rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /de yang rang don gzhan don gnyis su 'du/ /de bzhin tshad ma'i don rnams mdor bsdu na/ /gzhal bya mngon gyur lkog gyur shin lkog gsum/ /mjal byed mngon rjes dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung / /gsum gyis gzhal bya yongs su bsdu ba'o/ /de dag snying po tshul lngar 'du ba ni/ /chos can dbye gzhi chos kyi dbye ba dang / /nges bya'i rnam gzhag nges byed thal 'gyur dang / /lta ba dbu mar 'jug pa'i tshul lnga ru/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bsdus pa'o/ /tshad ma ce da pa'i rgyu rkyen dpe 'bras rnams/ /phun sum snurags pas rang rgyud rtogs pa 'phel/ /snyan pa'i grags

213'bar bstan pa 'dzin pa yi/ /cos kyi rgyal por 'gyur pa'i tshul la bslab/ ༈ /don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo rig mtha' yas kyang / /sgo gsum bzo la shes bya thams cad 'du/ /de la lus bzo ngag bzo yid bzo gsum/ /lus bzo mchog ni sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /dang po lha bzo gtsang sbra bsnyen gnas ldan/ /gsang sngags nang par dbang sgyu ba dam tshig can/ /bzo bo lhar bskyed lag cha tshon byin brlabs/ /sku yi cha tshad rnam bzhi mdo rgyud las/ /gsung mo da deng sang cha tshad bcu gcig tu/ /grags che kun kyang tshangs thig cadan song nas/ /chags bral 'o/ngas sku sor mo brgya nyer lnga / /byang sems brgya dang nyi shu drang srong khros/ /thal mo bcu gnyis yum rnams thal mo dgu /gshin rje gnod sbyin brgya dang srin po khros/ /drug lnga gsum sku da nyan rang mi dang mtshungs/ /tshangs sogs cha chen dgu yin gling bzhi'i mi/ /srid du mtho bdun zheng la brgyad du 'gyur/ /de dag las rlung 'gag pa'i rim par gsung / /zhi drag lha yi chas rgyan sna chongags dang / /phyag mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te rdo dril sogs/ /khri rgyab rgyan drug kun kyang skyon bral zhing / /rtsa ba yan lag tshon khyodar mdangs mdzes bya/ /rten gyi gzhal yas blos bslang rdul dza na dang / /sa bris kun kyang thig tshad rgyud bzhin bya/ /gsung rten gtso bo gsung rab slegs bam ste/ /rin chen las bskrun rim pa bdun ldan rgya/ /phyi nang gzhan spyor rnam bcu dbang

214ldan ni/ /e waṃ rang bzhin bris thig tshad dang ldan/ /bzo sprul yi ge gtso bo drug cu bzhi/ /mchog gyur lan grathra wartu'i yi ge dang / /lnga da yig gzab chen gzab chung 'byu che chung / /bshur ma dkyus yig drug ste de rnams kyang / /bsdu na dbu can dbu med gnyis su 'dus/ /thig btab sgrom btsal brgyud pa'i lag len ltar/ /phub dang dpung pa cha gcig zag mchur gnyis/ /rkang par cha gsum 'dogs 'brel cha bzhi dang / /steng gi yan lag cha gnyis de kun kyang / /gces brgyad 'don bcu ma chodas nyer gcig dang / /bu chos bcu drug spyi chodas gsum ldan dgos/ /snag shog smyu gu bzo yig tshul bzhin bya/ ༈ོ thugs rten spyi dang bye brag dbye ba mang / /yongs grags bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad ces/ /bkra shis 'byung ba byang mrub chos 'khor dang / /cho 'phrul lha babs dbyen zlum rnam rgyal dang / /myang 'das mchod rten so so'i tshad dbyibs dang / /spyi yi rnam dag mtshon don tshang bar bya/ /kun kyang baXge bo yon mnyes rab gnas ldan/ /rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bla na med/ /lngas bzo phal ba khang khyim gru gzings rgyan/ /gzhom srung 'phrul 'khor go mtshon la sdu/gas so/ ༈ /gnyis pa ngag bzo la yang mchog phal gnyis/ /mchog ni bstan la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yin / /lhan rgyas rol mo dbyangs kyi bye brag ni/ /dkon mchog mazod dang bltod dbyangs sngags kyi gdangs/ /nga

215ro bzhi dang yan lag bcu gnyis dang / /spel ma'i sbyor ba sgyur 'dren 'gyur thung sogs/ /sdig med dus tshod dgos pa ldan pa ste/ /sgrub mchod dbang bskur rab gnas dus ma 'das/ /gshin don sbyin sreg chen po drug la bya / / phal ba glu dang gling bu gral 'phros sogs/ ༈ /gsum pa yid bzo mchog ni mdo sngags kyi/ /legs gsungs thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab yin/ /phal pa rig gnas bsgu brgyad brtag pa brgyad/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi/ /de kun chos nor 'dod thar sde bzhir 'du/ /yid bzor shes bya'i rnam grangs kun 'dus so/ ༈ /lus srog gso bas rjes 'dzin gso rig ni/ /kun las khyad 'phags dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yi/ /dang po rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud nyid las/ /rtsa ba gsum las 'dril ba sdong po dgu /gyes pa'i yal ga bzhi bcu rtsa bdun te/ /lo 'dab nyis brgya rtsa bzhir rgyas pa yin/ /gsal ba'i me tog 'bras bu lnga ru smin/ /zhes gsungs mya ngan med pa'i ljon shing la/ /dper mdzad gso yul nad dang ngos 'dzin rtags/ /gso byed thabs la gso rig don rnams 'dus/ /bshad pa sku yi rgyu don tshul bzhi ste/ /gso bya gang phyir lus dang gang gso nad/ /gso byed spyod lam zas sman dpyad rnams te/ /gso thabs nad med gnas dang rnam 'gyur gso/ /gasdud mkhan rtsa ba yan lag bcas pas bsdus/ /man ngag yon tan rgyud don mdor bsdu na/ /lus dang byis

216pa mo nad gdon mcheran dug /rgas pa re tsa'i man ngag yan lag brgyad/ /gso dpyad che chung thams cad de las byung / /phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud don lag len te/ /kun btags gdon nad ltar snang 'phral gyi nad/ /yongs grub tshe nad gzhan dbang sngon las nad/ /re rer brgya rtsa gcig ste bzhi brgya bzhi/ /gso byed gnyen po sta nga dang rtsa gnyis rnams/ /bsdu na sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi/ /gso thabs lag len gsum brgya drug cu ste/ /bsdu na rtsa ba'i sde tshan lngar 'dus shing / /lag len bco brgyad grangs su dril ba'o/ /gso byed sman pa'i mtshan nyid rgyu drug ni/ /blo gros che zhing blo brtan blo gzeg pa/ /byams dang snying rje bsam pa dkar ba sogs/ /blo bzhag rnam pa drug dang gzung bya gnyis/ /shes pa gsum gyi dam tshig la gnas na/ /rang gzhan 'phral yun bde legs 'bras bur spyod/ ༈ /zlos gar zhes bya sngon gyi gtam rgyud dag /gzugs su byas te skad rigs so so yi/ /glu dbyangs zlos shing lus kyi gar byed pa / / glu yi khyad par bdun ldan ston pa'i gzhung / /don gyi chings gsum dang po mtshams sbyor gyi/ /yan lag lnga dang 'jug pa'i yan lag bzhi/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba sum cu rtsa drug ste/ /bha ra ta dang kun dga'i zlos gar sogs/ /dngos dang cha 'dra gangs can ljongs 'dir yang / /dri med kun ldan gzugs kyi nyi ma sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa

217spyad pa'i tshul/ /sems can mgu byed mthong ba don dang ldan/ ༈ོ /phyi nang rten 'brel kun rdzob blang dor rtsis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum las/ /nang ltar rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs bzhi/ /phyi rol 'jig rten snang bar bgrod bya'i yul/ /go lar khyim dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /de la bgrod byed zhi drag gza' bcu chags/ /rgyu skar khyim dang go la rlung 'gros kyis/ /nyin zhag re rer g.yas su 'khor ba dang / /mkha' la nyi mas khyim la g.yon skor spyod/ /sa yi dum bur dus bzhi g.yas su 'khor/ /gza' gzhan rang 'gros g.yon bskor skar khyim spyod/ /sgra gcan g.yas bskor rgyu skar lugs sgyu ga spyod/ /dus gsum zla drug mtshams su nyi zlar 'jug /nyi zla go la'i 'gros las zhag gsum byung / /nyi ma'i 'gros kyis nyin zhag dus sbyor dang / /chu tshod yud tsam dbugs dang chu srang dang / /chu tshod drug cus zhag rer go la 'khor/ /de las lo zla dus tshigs bzang ngan dang / /legs nyes 'bras bu gsal ston skar rtsis dang / /g.yul las rnam rgyal rgyud don dbyangs 'char rtsis/ /spor thang gtsug lag gzhung las 'byung rtsis so/ /rtsis la mkhas na grangs la mi rmongs zhes/ /rtsi byed iṅga'i ri mo 'bri ba dang / /'phri bsnan bsgyur dgod yi ge'i yan lag lnga/ /gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya dang / /bye ba dung phyur dgu po rkyang pa'i grangs/ /khug pa'i grangs ni ther 'bum khrag khrig dang / /rab

218bkram gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang / /spang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang rgyu rigs dang / /'od mdzes dbang po legs phyin tog 'gro dang / /'byin rdul brgya rtags stobs 'aspo/ ra brda shes dang / /rnam 'byung stobs mig nyal nyul wal sngo la dang / khyad khyud phyad phyin grangs med drug cu'o/ /'di las ches mang grangs kyi ming tshig ni/ /phal po che sogs mdo las gsungs pa'ang sku da/ /mtha' dag 'phags pa'i spyod yul kho na'o/ ༈ོ de ltar thun mong rig gnas kun shes nas/ /thun min rgyal bstan nang malnga da dam pa'i chos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po'i bcud bsdus pa / / 'dod sdang rmongs pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po mchog /rjod byed 'dul mngon mdo sde'i sde snod la/ /thos dang bsam sgom shes rab la brten nas/ /brjod bya tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyi/ /rnam dag bslab pa gsum la legs goms pas/ /spangs rtogs sku na tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /gzung spobs ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bo 'phang mchog brnyes 'gyur/ /khyad par sangs rgyas las kyang ches dkon pa'i/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam mchog /rim gnyis spyod dang bcas pa'i nyams len kyang / /yi ge'i lam la ma brten ji ltar 'grub/ /des na thun mong rig gnas ji snyed dang / /thun min rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod mdo sngags

219rnams/ /yi ger ma brten shes pa'i gnas med pas/ /de phyir skal bzang thar 'dod skyes bu rnams/ /thog ma kho nar tshul 'dir 'jug par rigs/ /yi ge'i byed po 'jam dbyangs thon mis kyang / /rjes 'jug bcu sogs yi ge'i don shes na/ /'dri dang klog dang bshad pa thams cad kyi/ /tshig thodan mtshams sbyor sgra la thogs med cing / /'brel bar smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur zhes dang / /yi ge bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /skyes bu gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /rnam 'byed shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dang por 'di nyid bslab ces gsungs/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di nyid snying dbus —kyi/ /bum par bzung nas la 'ur cis mi 'jug /rnam grol thar pa'i grong du 'gro ba yi/ /lta ba'i mig gcig zla med yi ge ste/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma 'di shes na/ /rtsom sogs mkhas pa'i bya bar rang dbang du/ /spyod cing don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar rig gnas nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi/ /sgo brgya cig car 'byed la thogs med pa'i/ /'phrul gyi lde mig yi ge 'di kho na/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal las kyang / /phyi dus nga nyid yi gephyi gzugs su 'ongs/ /de tshe de la gus pa skyed ces gsungs/ /de phyir yi ge sangs rgyas sprul pa ste/ /'di 'dra mjal ba skal pa bzang snyam du/ /gus pas bslab na 'chad

220rtsod rtsom sogs kyi/ /mkhas pa'i mchog brnyes bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'grub/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yi ges 'dzin dbo sa pas/ /snag smyug sbyin pa'ang ye shes chosags yin par/ /mdo las gsungs pa'i tshul sogs shes byas nas/ /bsod nams ye shes che gas gnyis rdzogs 'dod rnams/ /gsung mchog yi ge'i 'du byed nyid la brtson/ /mkhas pa'i go 'phang bde blag thob 'dod na/ /thog mar rig lam sgo 'byed 'dir 'jug bya / / de phyir mkhas dbang bstan dar lha rams pas/ /mang du thos kyang 'chad la mi mkhas na/ /sman gyis dbul ba'i sman pa mkhas pa bzhin/ /rtsod la mkhas kyang ce ma tshul mi shes na/ /lce brgya sprul nas smras kyang lkugs pa yin/ /rtsom pa legs kyang sug bris ma 'byor na/ /dpa' rtsal che ba'i dpa' bo lag rdum 'dra/ /rtsom tshig sum rtags ji bzhin ma byung na/ /mkhas pa shin tu khrel bas bag sku da bya/ /yi ge dag kyang snyan ngag mi ldan na / / bud med mdzes ma sgren mor rgyu ba bzhin/ /macadan bajosgod gsar rnying brda yis ma spud na/ /grong tshig 'dres pas mkhas pas dor byar 'os/ /de phyir rig gnas chung ba dag /sbyang rin med ces ma dor bar/ /kun la zhib tu sbyangs byas na/ /da gzod mkhas pa'i gral 'go dbang / /zhes sogs mkhas pa'i gsung las mang du 'byung / /des na rang re bod kyi yi ge 'di/ /yig rigs gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i

221chos/ /du ma dang ldan 'di la nges par slob/ /de yang klog shes tsam gyis ma tshim par/ /bris gzugs brda dag sdeb spyor sgra don rnams/ /khong du r+yād na gzhan la ma ltos par/ /rang stobs kho nas rig gzhung mtha' dag gi /dka' gnad mdud brgya ma lus cig car du/ /'grol nus che gsal myur zab shes rab stobs/ /me ltar 'bar ba yi ge'i byin rlabs yin/ /yi ge 'bri klog shes na sangs rgyas kyi/ /lung gi bstan dang mjal ba zhes bya zhing / /de las rtogs pa'i bstan pa rang rgyud la/ /nges par skye ba dngos po'i chos nyid lags/ /de phyir yi ge'i tshul 'dir ska'/ ldan rnams/ /'jug par mdzod ces lhag bsam zla zer gyis/ /bskul tshig ga bur zegs ma 'grems lags pas/ /gzur gnas skal bzang ku mud dga' ba'i tshal/ /che sa che ra bzhad pa'i dga' sta na spyod par 'tshal/ /mkhas pas bsten 'os mkhas mang legs bshad las/ /byis blos nyer bsdus byis pa dga' byed dang / /shes rab 'phel phyir shes rab bslab pa la/ /slob pa'i rim pa slob 'dod don du bkod/ /de ltar tshogs gsum tshul las brtsams pa'i tshig /tshig nyung don mang 'dus pa 'di bris dge /dge legs 'byung gnas bstan dar 'brel thogs kun/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas sa la myur 'jug shog /ces yi ge dang / ming dang / tshig gi tshogs pa mdo tsam brjod pa zhar byung rig gnas kyi sngom tshig nyung ngu
(phorko 'ong ḍa ( thihūṃg waṃl)sloyosnyelngagyi 'angashu’’7methoci//ji( lte richochiji trī

223drug pa/༄༅༅/ /shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rig sgo zhes bya ba'i sdom tshig༈ོ na mo gu ru ya/ chodas kun shes dang shes bya gnyis su 'du/ /de la chodas zhes bya ba'i sgra nyid kyang / /shes bya lam dang myang 'das yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab 'byung 'gyur nges/ /chos lugs la ste bcu la 'jug pa'o/ /shes byar dbye na rtag pa dngos po gnyis/ /dang por rnam pa thams cad pa dang ni/ /res 'ga' ba yi rtag pa gnyis su 'dod/ /gnyis par gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum/ /gzugs la nang gi gzugs dang phyi yi gzugs/ /nang gi gzugs ni mig gi dbang po dang / /rna ba sma dang lce dang lus dbang lnga'o/ /phyi yi gzugs ni gzugs kyi skye mched dang / /sgra dri ro dang reg bya'i skye mched lnga'o/ /dang po gzugs la kha nge ga dbyibs gnyis te/ /kha nge ga la yang rtsa ba yan lag gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i kha dog dkar dmar ser sngo bzhi/ /yan lag sprin dang du ba rdul khug

224sna/ /snang mun grib ma nyi ma'i 'od zer brgyad/ /gnyis pa dbyibs la ring thung lham dang zlum/ /mtho dma' phya le phya le ma yin brgyad/ /gnyis pa sgra yi skye mched dbang po yis/ /zin dang ma zin 'byung 'gyur sgra gnyis te/ /re re'ang lung du ston dang mi ston dang / /snyan dang mi snyan gnyis gnyis phye bas brgyad/ /de la'ang sgra yi brjod bya rjod byed gnyis/ /rjod byed sgra la'ang nang gses bzhir dbye ste/ /ngo bo'i dbang gis ming tshig yi ge gaskum/ /brdzod bya'i dbang du rigs brjod tshogs brjod gnyis/ /brjod tshul dbang gis mi ldan rnam gcod dang / /gzhan ldan rnam gcod mi srid rnam gcod gsum/ /rjod 'dod dbang gis chodas can brjod r+shapa dang / /snu sa brjod sgra gnyis bcas su dbye ba'o/ /gsum pa dri la zhim dang mi zhim gnyis/ /re re la yang mnyam dang mi mnyam gnyis/ /lhan skyes dri dang sbyar byung dri ste brgyad/ /bzhi pa ro la mngar skyur tsha ba dang / /lan tshwa ba dang kha ba ska ba drug /re rer mngar ba'i mngar dang skyur ba sogs/ /drug drug dbye bas sum cu rtsa drug ste/ /de rer myang 'ju zhu rjes lus sems la/ /phan pa'i ro sogs gsum gsum dbye ba yis/ /ro yi bye brag brgya dang brgyad yod de/ /lnga pa reg bya'i skye mched dbye na ni/ /'byung bar gyur dang 'byung gyur reg bya gnyis/ /dang po 'byung ba sa chu me rlung bzhi/ /gnyis pa 'byung 'gyur reg bya 'jam rtsub

225dang / /lci yang grang ba bkres dang skom pa bdun/ ༈ོ /gnyis pa shes pa'am blo yi dbye ba ni/ /sems dang sems byung rtog bcas rtewag med dang / /slo rig bdun dang tshad ma tshad min gnyis/ /rtogs pa'i blo dang ma rtogs blo'i dbye ba/ /'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes pa dbye dang drug /de la dang po sems dang sems byung gi /dang po sem sa dang yid dang rnam par shes/ /gtso sems bzhi dze don gcig dbye na drug /mig gi rnam shes rna ba sna lce lus/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang drug go /gnyis pa sems byung dbye ba nga gcig ste/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga dang ni/ /rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu dang / /dge ba bcu gcig gzhan 'gyur bzhi rnams so/ /kun 'gro lnga ni tshor ba 'du shesdo/ dang / /sems pa reg pa yid byed lnga rnams so/ /yul nges lnga ni bdun pa mos pa dang / dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab dang lnga'o/ /rtsa nyon drug ni 'dod chags khong khro dang / /nga rgyal ma rig lta ba the tshom drug /nye nyon nyi shu khro ba 'khon 'dzin dang / /'chab pa 'tshig pa phrag dog ser sna sgyu / /g.yo dang rgyags pa rnam 'tshe ngo tsha med/ /khrel med rmugs nga/ rgong nga ma dad pa / /le lo bag med brjed nges shes bzhin min/ /rnam par g.yeng ba dang bcas nyi shu'o/ /dge ba zhes bya dad pa ngo tsha shes/ /khrel yod 'dod chags med dang zhe sdang med/ /gti mug med pa brtson 'grus shin sbyangs dang / /bag sku da pa

226dang de bzhin btang lha mas dang / /rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang bcu gcig smo /gzhan 'gyur zhes bya gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang / /rtog pa dang ni dpyod pa bzhi yin no/ /gnyis pa rtewag bcas rtog med dbye ba gnyis/ /dang po ming sbyor don sbyor rtog pa dang / /shodag pa don mthun yin min dbye ba dang / /thos bsam sgom pa gsum gyi rtog pa'o/ /rtog med bum 'dzin mig shes lta bu la/ /yod pa gsal snang can gyi mngon sum dang / /med pa gsal snang can gyi log shes so/ /gsum pa slo rig bdun du dbye ba ni/ /mngon sum rjes dpag bcad shes yid dpyod dang / /snang la ma nges the tshom log shes so/ /dang po mngon sum nyid la dbye na lnga / /gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon sgra dang dri ro dang / /reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i mngon sum mo/ /mngon sum ltar snang la yang 'khrul ba'i rgyu/ /yul rten gnas dang 'phral rkyen la yod bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa rjes dpag dngos stodabs rjes dpag dang / /grags pa'i rjes dpag yid ches rjes dpag gsum/ /gsum pa bcad shes mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis/ /bzhi pa yid dpyod rgyu mtshan med pa dang / /rgyu mtshan can gyi yid daphyod gnyis su 'dod/ /lnga pa snang la ma nges pa yi blo/ /mig shes dang ni lus shes su gyur pa'i/ /snang la ma nges pa yi blo gnyis yod/ /drug pa the tshom la yang don 'gyur dang / /don mi 'gyur dang cha mnyam the dza ma gsum/ /bdun pa log shes rtewag pa log

227shes dang / /rtog med log shes gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /bzhi pa tshad ma dang ni tshad min gnyis/ /dang por mngon sum rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/ /dbye na gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon la sogs lngaso// /tshad min shes par bcad the/sa yid dpyod dang / /snang la ma nges the tshom log shes lnga'o/ /lnga pa rtog pa'i blo dang ma rtog blo/ /dang por dngos su rtogs dang shugs rtogs gnyis/ /gnyis par ma rtogs 'i/ga rtogs the tshom gsum/ /drug pa 'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes pa gnyis/ /dang por rtog med 'khrul pa'i shes pa dang / /rtog pa 'khrul med gnyis su dbye ba'o/ ༈ོ gnyis pa dngos po'i rgyu sogs dbye ba la/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu gsum du dbye ba la/ /rang mtshan spyi mtshan bden gnyis dbye ba dang / /mtshan nyid gsum dang rdzas ldog dbye ba dang / /mtshan mtshon dbye ba spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /'gal 'brel gnyis dang dgag sgrub dbye ba dang / /gcig dang tha dad yul dang yul can dang / /mngon lkog dbye ba bcas te bcu gnyis so/ /dang po rgyu rkyen 'bras bu bshad pa yi/ /rgyu la dalnga sa kyi rgyu dang brgyud rgyu dang / /nyer len rgyu dang lhan cig byed rkyen bzhi'o/ /rkyen la rgyu yi rkyen dang dmigs rkyen dang / /bdag po'i rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen bzhi'o/ /'bras bu la yang dngo sa 'bras brgyud 'bras gnyis/ /gnyis pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid dbye ba ni/ /she bya gang zhig rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /grub dang ma grub

228pa yis dbye ba'o/ /gsum pa don dam kun rdzob bden gnyis ni/ /rtog pas btags tsam min par rang ngos nas/ /grub pa'i chos la don dam bden pa dang / /rtog pas btags pa tsam du grub pa'i chos/ /kun rdzob bden pa zhes su 'dod pa'o/ /bzhi pa mtshan nyid gsum du dbye ba la/ /kun btags dang ni gzhan dbang yongs gyub gsum/ /dang por mtshan nyid chad pa'i kun btags dang / /rnam grangs pa yi kun btags gnyis su 'dod/ /gzhan dbang gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum/ /yongs grub chos dang gang zag bdag med gnyis/ ༈ /lnga pa rdzas chos stodag chos dbye ba gnyis/ /dang por rigs pas grub pa'i rdzas yod dang / /brtan pa mi 'gyur don byed nus pa dang / /rang skya 'dzin pa'i rdzas yod dang bzhi'o/ /drug pa mtshan mtshon gnyis su dbye ba la/ /rdzas sku da chos gsum tshang ba mtshan nyid dang / /btags yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshon bya'o/ /bdun pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis dbye ba/ /rang gi gsal bar rjes 'gro'i chos spyi dang / /khyab rjes 'jug pa'i rang rigs can bye brag /brgyad pa 'gal 'brel gnyis su dbye ba la/ /dang por lhan cig mi gnas 'gal ba dang / /phan tshun spang 'gal gnyis te re rer yang / /dngos 'gal dang ni brgyud 'gal gnyis gnyis so/ /'brel ba la yang nang gses gnyis yod de/ /bdag nyid gcig 'brel de byung 'brel ba'o/ /dgu pa dgag

229skrub gnyis su dbye ba la/ /dgag bya bcad nas rtogs par bya min pa'i/ /chos gang sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa dang / /dgag pa la yang ma yin dgag dang ni/ /med dgag gnyis te dang por dngos dang shugs/ /gnyis kar 'phangs dang skabs thob 'phangs bzhicod/ /med dgag shes byar srid min dgag pa gnyis/ /bcu pa gcig dang tha dad dbye ba la / / dang por rang ldog ngo bo rigs rdzas bzhi/ /gcig pa'o ldog pa la yang gsum/ /tha dad la yang rang ldog tha dad dang / /ngo bo rigs rdzas tha dad dang bzhi'o/ /bcu gcig yul dang yul can gnyis bshad pa/ /tshad mas rtogs par bya ba'i yul de la/ /snang yul zhen yul 'dzin stangs kyi yul dang / /'jug yul dngos yul dmigs yul rnams drug go /rang yul la 'jug shes pa'ang gsum yod de/ /shes pa dag dang gzugs gyur yul can dang / /ldan min 'du byed du gyur yul can no/ /bcu gnyis mngon lkog gnyis su dbye ba la/ /dang por gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum/ /gnyis par rjes dpags gsum gyi 'jug yul lo/ /de ltar sdom tshig rtsa ba blo brtan na/ /gzhung don yal 'dab lo 'bras rgyas 'gyur phyir/ /'di bris dge bas bdag gzhan/ 'gro kun gyis/ /shes byar thogs med blo gros mchog thob shog/ //ces pa'ang dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs
4 —༈ ci— ༷༷trī sdo3༈paṃram̐lhusnyozhezazhibyucuzirdzoṣetrehūṃri ṭidz+wargu—d+kuyotso/byuskosnyosdo //lhage 'i

bdun pa/༄༅༅//rang cag kha ba ri pa rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i thugs rje bka' drin dran pa'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs 'asnga da don myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//༈ na mo gu ru/zab gsal mi 'gyur bde ba'i ye shes dbyings//lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo'i sprin//spro mkhas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs mchog/phyag na pasdu'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal//srid par dub pa'i yid can srid do cog/nyer zhi'i rnam grol lam la nyer bkri ba'i//ngo mtshar mdzad rlabs mtshungs pa med pa'i sde//bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam 'dren gzhan gyis bor ba'i lnga bdo'i

232dus/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mabo na du rgyal ba yis/ /bsngags pa ro/na ldan sngo mtshar 'phrin las kyis/ /gsal ba'i gzhal dka'i bka' drin mchog tu dran/ /skye rgu spyi dang lhag par gangs ljongs la/ /gang thugs btang snyoms dgongs pa skad cig kyang / /lhod pa'i skabs med nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /thugs rjes yodangs bzung bka' drin rtag tu dran/ /chos tshigs yul dbus chos ldan gangs ri'i khrod/ /log spyod kla klo'i log lta gdug rtsub kyis/ /bkab pa'i mun nag ma lus sel mdzad pa'i/ /snang ba'i dga' ston stsol ba'i bka' drin dran/ /bdag sogs sngon byas dkar min las kyi 'bras/ /bsad 'phredag 'thab brdung gnon gazlogag khrag gi dus/ /sku/la nas zhi bde chos nor 'dod thar gyi/ /skal bzang stsol ba'i bka' drin lhag par dran/ /las dbang rnam smin bdud sdes btsir gnon 'og /bstir med gnas 'dra duḥkhas cher gdung yang / /snying rje'i gter chen thabs mkhas thugs rje'i mthus/ /bde bar dbugs dbyung mdzad pa'i bka' drin dran/ /las 'bras rnam smin gzhan dbang bkol spyod brgyas/ /'jigs skrag bkres ltogs dbul phongs sdug bsngal gyis/ /bcings par babo la nas zhi bde chos srid kyi/ /skal bzang dga' ston stsol ba'i bka' drin dran/ /gang gis g.yel med brtse bas rtag gzigs kyang / /bdag so/gas las kyi nongs pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /log pa'i lam du chu sna gar khrid

233ltar/ /rgyug pa'i blun rmongs nyes tshogs snying nas bshags/ /gyi na'i bya dga' go sa zol bstod tsam/ /snying por 'khrul nas 'di phyi bstan srid rnams/ /'dor ba'i col chung chos bral lta ngan gyi/ /mun par 'thom pa'i skal ngan 'thol zhing bshags/ /phyin chad las 'bras dge sdig blang dor la/ /gang gi bka' bzhin bsgrub pa lhur blangs te/ /kla klo'i lta ngan dug chu'i dri ma rnams/ /bkrus nas thar lam thob par byin gyis chodabs/ /mthodang grol mtshan dpe'i gser zhal sku'i dkyil 'khor/ /gang gi dgyes zhing gangs ljongs chos srid khrir/ /myur ba myur bar bkod pa'i dge legs kyi/ /rdzogs ldan skal bzang dga' ston ches cher stsol/ /bdag sogs 'bangs rnams mgon khyed kho na las/ /re ba'i skyabs gzhan su la'ang ma mchis pa/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du thugs rje yis/ /rjes bzung byin rlabs dngos gyub stsal du gsol/ /rmad byung sras bcas sku gas/ces pa 'di ni chos min kla klo'i dpung gi btsan gnon drag rtsub kyi duḥkha mi bzad pa'i gcong rong du tshud kyang / slar yang rang dbang chos 'gyor bde skyid kyi dpal la myur du spyod pa'i skal bzang ni/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i thugs rje dang bka' drin kho na yin par yang yang yid la dran te/ gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa'i bod ljongs lha 'bangs nang pa mtha' dag dad gus 'gyur med kyi rang bzhin rgyu mtshan du mas gsal bar mtshon pa ltar/ spyi mgrin bka' drin rjes dran gyi gsol 'debs su yi ger 'god pa po ni/ mgon po mchog gi bka' 'bangs tha shal ba ma tī'i ming can gyis rab rgyal lcags bya dzad 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes la bris pa dge'o//
234tshul 'di dge slong blo bzang rin chen nas//dus 'das slo ldan ched du par bskrun dges//tshe rabs //na tu phyag na pad+mo yis//rjes bzung sa lam yon tan yongs rdzogs shog/ //

brgyad pa/dzo//lharabacasasridazhi'igasnagaṭ+wāṃn7ldibasalte mgaspya 7rgyal doba~X thams cad mardin ga ṭ+wāṃs chan pa mchag la bstad nga gsal ba 'dabs pa rab tu byed pa byin rlabs snying 'jag bkra shis char chen da bi༄ 0oṃ si zhasabyab dzabye ra/ yi ribartse ṭ+wāṃs pa snacig/ ༷byedī kau~Xso~X gaṭ+wāṃ dhi+oḍi// dz+nyoX /tram̐sam py-i+o zhi/'i/ sna~Xshā py-i+or thams cad masngin/ri/7rgyal dbang bstasngi ༷na rgya ༷tsho rgyaX gyuḍi mapy-id /༵dī dīhūṃ sdo~Xrdo rta~Xr rna/ma /dīdī ṭ+wāṃkhru ṭ+wāṃji pahūṃsam bra/la py-i/py-i ༵ salamazha daṭ+wāṃX ri gra gyi tshatsha ༄ risgyur zhas//gas dkar dpal nga mar stel la bstad//mtha' mad

236'khor ba'i khams su 'phyan pa'i 'gror/ /rjes chags snying rje'i mu khyud mi shigs pas/ /'ching bachodad dmigs med thugs rje mi baphyogel ba/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes rab 'byams zhing du grags/ /rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa'i bka' lung bzhin/ /byang phyogs rab dkar kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /thub bstan nyin mor mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'bum/ /mtha' dag smra bsam bcadad pa'i yul las 'das/ /dge 'dun grub pa dpal nas gang gi bar/ /gser mdog ring lugs gur gum bla bo sa kyis/ /kun bzod lang tshor klubs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /khyedags kun snyan 'bar grags pa'i ba dan mdzes/ /lhag par mabo na khyed gangs stodangs chos srid khrir/ /phebs te ris med yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bstan/ /nyin mo'i lang tsho rdzogs pa'i snang ba la/ /chodas ldan 'bangs rnams sngon med dga' ston cadang / /de lta'i chos srid dri med pad dkar dri/ /rab mngar ngo mtshar bye bas ring bskyangs pa'i/ /bka' drin tshul 'dir bdag sogs bod 'bangs rnams/ /bsam zhing mgon khyod dad gus lhag par 'phel/ /de lta'i dge mtshan tshul la mi baX da pa'i/ /log smon chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi sde/ /glo bur lhags shing phyi nang nag phyogs dpung / /bdo bas gang gi gsang gsum tshul la'ang 'tshe/ /mabo na khyed ring nas srid zhi'i dgra tshogs las/ /rgyal phyir mtshan dpe'i mdzes sku nyin morware mgo na/ /yid bsrub mun pas sgrib

237par mi nus phyir/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gzi byin lhag par 'phel/ /bslu brid zlos gar ltad mo'i mtshang gzigs shing / /drag sbyor g.yul gyi gasku thabs slongs pa'i skabs/ /dus kyi zod rig bder bgrod zhi thabs la / / mkhas khyod zla med thams cad mkhyen par grags/ /sa mtshams sa srung mel tshe mu 'khyud kyis/ /bskor yang skor zhib gang gi'ang yul min par/ /'phags pa 'phags pa'i yul du 'khor dang bcas/ /ci bder spyod de ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul nyid/ /rgya gar sa skyong gtsug gi nor bus bkur/ /'dzam gling rgyal khab che rgus mchod cing bsnyen/ /chodags gnyis mnga' thang dpal gyi 'byor ba'i sprin/ /nam mkha'i mdzod 'dra gang gi rnam thar tshul/ /legs mdzad mtha' dag rgya chen bstan 'gro'i don/ /nyid phyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul grur yang / /nang pa'i chos sde sum brgya nyi shur lhag /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun brgyad stong lhag par 'phel/ /kun kyang rnam dag tshul khrims gtsang ma yis/ /mde sngags bshad sgrub chodas sgra chad med du/ /sgrogs pa'i sngon med thub bstan dar ba la/ /'dzam gling rgyal khab kun gyis gus pas mchod/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khyad chodas ni/ /mchog tu gyur ces 'dzam gling mkhas kun bsngags/ /phyi mo la pa yang nang pa'i bstan pa la/ /zhugs pa ches mang sngon med grags pa 'bar/ /rnam par mtho rtsal gso rig sgra snyan rtsis/ /sna tshogs skad

238yig sgyu rtsal tshan rig sogs/ /thun mong rig gnas kun la'ang bod rigs rnams/ /mkhas zhes grags pa'ang mgon khyod 'phrin las nyid/ /sel dka' 'khon gyi 'gal ba sdum par yang / /cis kyang 'da' bar mi nus 'phags pa'i bka'/ /drang srong gsung gi bden pa'i che ba yis cher rlom dregs ldan khengs pa ming du gyur/ /dam nag chu gnyer rlabs kyi nal tshogs dang / /sus kyang sdudag par mi nus 'jigs chen yang / /mgon khyod ting 'dzin dgongs pa skad cig gis/ /gzhil ba'i ngo mtshar grags pas srid gsum khyab/ /khyod zhabs bkra shis rdul gyi 'khor 'orware ris//'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la yongs bkod de/ /brgya phrag nye ba'i rgyal khab rgyal 'bangs rnams/ /rnam grol zhi ba bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stsol/ /lha med smra ba kla klo'i lta ngan gyis/ /'dzam gling chos lugs yongs su snubs nye'i tshe/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po khyod byon nas/ /'dzam gling sku ngas rdzogs yang dag lta la bkod/ /ye shu gnam bdag i si lam sogs kyang / /so so'i ston pa ji bzhin gus bkur ni/ /ji ltar lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar me mdzad/ /ris med sde pa kun gyis bkur pa bzhin/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung gis chos sgo brgyad khri'i mdzod/ /sna tshogs skad dang mos pa rgya mtsho bzhin/ /ston mdzad ngo mtshar gsung gi mdzad pa'i tshul/ /thub dbang slar yang byon 'dra khyod la bstod/ /dad gsum mi 'gyur sri zhu bkur

239sni dang / /lta log bdud dang 'byung po/sa brlam pa gnyis/ /byams sdang dmigs pa nyer zhi snying rje'i gter/ /khyod 'dra 'dzam gling sa steng su yang med/ /'gro ba mi mi rigs gyur ji snyed dang / /srog chags grog sbur dud 'gro grangs med tshul/ /srog skyob 'di phyir dge ba'i zhi bde la/ /'god mdzad snying rje'i gter chen khyod kho na/ /de phyir gang gi rma tshan snyan grags pa'i sprin/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal 'khor 'edere zhabs sen rdul/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten che rgu'i gtsug gtor gyi/ /rtse na mngo na par mdzes la gus pas bstod/ /khams ga3shim za byed khro rgyal rdo rje grags/ /kho sa pa'i khro tshogs drag pos zhing gyur gyi/ /bdud gzugs phye mar brlag pa'i rgyal rnga'i dbyangs/ /'dzam bu'i sgra ldan khyon las rnam par brgal/ /dkar phyo gas rgyal ba'i rgyal rnga srid rtser brdung / /nag phyogs pham pa'i ru dar sa la bsnyal/ /'dzam gling chos sri da zhi bde'i dga' ston la/ /bh+yod pa'i skal bzang mgon khyod bka' drin nyid/ /dus ring gdung ba'i duḥkha las grol zhing / /yid bsrub gzhi/la las rnam rgyal dus kyi char/ /rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal 'di macon khyod kyis/ /gangs/ ljongs skyong ba'i thugs bskyed mthu las byung / /yid can s+t+ri dang lhag par 'jam gling 'gro/ /gdul bya spyi dang gangs ri'i lha 'bangs la/ /rtag tu thugs brtse'i gzigs pa mi 'dor ba/ /snying rje'i gter chen mchodag la gus pas bstod/ /gang

240gi gsang gsum yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdzod/ /mtha' dag thub pa'i ljags kyang gtugs byed na/ /phal gyis spyodas ci 'on kyang cha shas tsam/ /shugs byung dad pa rgyas pa'i mthu las skyes/ /mgon po'i yon tan bsngags pa rgya che ba'am/ /tha na tshigs bcad gcig tsam brjod pa'ang rung / /de yi ming tshig yi ge'i grangs snyed kyi/ /bsod nams thob par gyur la su mi bce na/ /de lta na yang lam dang lam min dang / /chos dang chos min gang gi bka' drin sogs/ /mi shes blun po sku/ga lam 'phyan dag la/ /masku na khyod lhag par brtse ba 'phags pa'i chos/ /'ga' zhig kun rtog log pa'i gnas min bstod/ /kha cig sger phan spyi gasna da kho nar gzhol/ /la la dbyen dkrug phra ma'i tshul la dga'/ /phal cher mi smra'i tshul gyis mgon khyod sgom/ /kha gcig chu lha'i phyogs su lce brgya g.yod/ /la la dbang gzhu'i tshon mdangs bkra la g.yeng / /phal cher dpyangs thag nyid la brten mod kyi/ /kun kyang chos kyi 'khor sgyur 'bangs su nges/ /bdag sogs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus skyes kyang / /rje khyod mgon du thob pa'i skal bzang ni/ /tshangs dbang 'khor sgyur bye ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /rnyed dka' bde blag rnyed 'di da res tsam/ /shes ldan su zhig tshul 'di rtogs gyur na / / dam chos kho nar mgon khyod bka' ji bzhin/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad pa don yod kyis/ /tshe 'dir don gnyis rnyin grub cis mi

241brtson/ /rin chen khums brgya bkod pa'i 'ing kham/sa spyin/ /bskal brgyar phul kyang gzhal dka'i bka' drin cha/ /sasab phyir bka' bzhin bsgru ba bya chos spyod bcur/ /dam bca' mi 'gyur ri mo snying la 'god/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod zhabs rdul dang / /mi 'bral gsung si bdud rtsir longs spyod cing / /khyod gsung nyan cing sgo gsum bya ba kun/ /khyod masnye/sa 'ab3 zhig sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus sku spyan ras gzigs/ /bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i bsod nams sang thob nges yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub grur cig /chos tshigs yu' dbus chos/ ldan 'ing khams 'dir/ /chos nor 'dod bde thar pa'i dpal yon la/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin legs spyod pa'i/ /chos srid rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/ces pa 'ang dam pa 'i bka' dang rkyen 'gas bskul bar brten/ rab ngus (rka(༄/ rgyal ṅgā'i yar tshes la ma tī'i ming gis bris pa dge legs 'phel/

4dgu pa/༄༅༅//'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog la netshibastad ༷༷sa gas su bcad pa skabs gsum bdag pa' rgyal rnga zhes bya ba bi dza ha ram̐//bcoṭ+wā+oṃ ldaḍi ༵ ṭ+wāṃ//ba/byebyeḍiṭ+wāṃ ༵ rgyadīr ༵ dgabazhi/rdo dīdā sngi ṭ+wā+oṃ dī ༵dīg/ me/ṭ+wāṃ )༷sa trom̐py-ig stsol rgyarjo ba rgyas mtshod dīs/nyi/ṭ+wāṃ mthaḍi yardzu pa'i shis pa 'bum gya kya/ga/ri/34khyanapa bad ga ༷// gzags /rdojacas dpa95 dbyangs//baṭ+wāṃbasakham/sa gsum daXgasa'aX spya na rasagaṭ+wāṃs//nus pas bdud ba mothar mdzad gas nga ba' bdagamu/rags gsuX gagaru bsdus gangs can mgan pa rgyal/ /gang la gcag twa dad cang bstan pa

243las/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen 'gyur zhing / /mtshan tsam thodas pas thar pa mdzadag ste ra ba/ /phyag na pajo re zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs rgyal sras kyi/ /rnam rol rab 'byams zhing du sgyu 'phrul brgyas/ /gang 'dul theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo yis/ /dbang sgyur rgyal ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /shes byar thogs med ye shes spun ras stong / /'gro la snying rjes mi 'dzum gzigs pa yis/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por ྾ ྾ ྾ / /theg ga3/ma chos kyis mtha' 'khob yul dbus su/ /bsgyur te bskal brgyar thos dka' rdo rje'i theg /khyab gdal 'og min zhing ltar rgyas mdzad pa/ /rje btsun dang po'i mgon la ྾ ྾ ྾/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab dri med gsang mdzod gzugs/ /gsal sngo gas ye shes me long las 'ongs pa'i/ /legs bshad chos mdzod bye ba'i gter grol ba/ /'jam dpal ngag gi dbang por ྾ ྾ ྾ / /ris med rgyal bstan ñtsi dang de'i yang snying / /'jam dpal ring lugs dri med gser sbyangs khams/ /spel la 'jam mgon bla ma slar byon pa/ /chod bzang ye shes zhabs la ྾ ྾ ྾ / /rtag par brtse ba las skyes brtson 'grus ches/ /thub pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas zhing kun tu/ /spel la mi 'jigs ma 'dres stobs mnga' ba'i/ /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs

244la ྾ mo mo / /tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs mtshan dpe'i mdzes sku'i zhabs/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten che rgu'i gtsug gtor rtser/ /bkod pa'i dzadas kyi rgyal thabs skyong mkhas pa/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur zhabs la mo mo gli/ /bdud kyi mi tshugs chogs gnyis sa bcu'i lha bas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal rnam thar gzi byin 'bum/ /phyogs bcur rgyas pas rgyal bstan nyin mo ltar/ /gsal mdzad mtshungs pa med la mo mo mo/ /rab 'byams sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir/ /thos bsam sgom dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i mgon po sa gsum gyi/ /rnam 'dren mtshungs pa med la mo ྾ ྾/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab zag med kyi/ /rgya chen dza gas gnyis pha rol phyin pa'i lam/ /zab gsang rim gnyis zung 'jug go 'phang 'bras/ /stsol mdzad mtshungs pa med la mo ྾ ྾/ /kun nyon 'ching ba kun gce da rnam byang gi /shes rab ral gri sher phyin chos mdzod ches/ /mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar mdzes sku chos kun gzigs/ / mkhyen rab mtshungs pa med la ྾ mo ྾/ /ring goms gzugs bskyed rin chen byang chub sems/ /rab rgyas snying rje dmigs med pad+ma dkar/ /bsngags 'os mchog 'chang thugs rje mi bshol ba'i/ /brtse chen mtshungs pa med la mo ྾ mo/ /kun khyab bde chen chos dbyings snying po dang / /mi phyed ye shes rdo rje mtshon char gyis/ /'jig lta'i bdud ri

245mthar mdzad mthu chen thob/ /nus stobs mtshungs pa med la ྾ ྾ ྾/ /ye shes sgru ma'i bkod pa gang chen mtsho/ /rab 'byams zhing khams kun khyab sku'i gsang ba/ /bgrangs yas 'gro ngor de snyed du ma'i gar/ /sku mchog mtshungs pa med la ྾ mo mo / /srid zhi'i dge legs kun gter dkon mchog mdzod/ /sta na mdzad tshangs dbyangs yan lag gsung gcig gis/ /kun gyi skad bzhin go mdzad ngo mtshar dbyangs/ /gsung mchog mtshungs pa med la ྾ mo mo / /srid zhir mi gnas lhan skyes snying rje'i nyams/ /'bo la rjes chags chu gter g.yo ba'i rlabs/ /dus las yol med gdul bya'i khams la 'jug /thugs mchog mtshungs pa med la mo mo ྾/ /bsod nams brgya pa'i phyag stong 'khor 'o/sa sgyur/ /ye shes spyan stong bskal bzang rnam 'dren te/ /gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i spangs rtogs kyi/ /sku/na tan mtshungs pa med la ྾ ྾ ྾/ /gang mtshan sangs rgyas bye ba 'bum dang mnyam/ /'gro 'dul legs mdzad 'dren pa yongs dang mtshungs/ /lhan grub chad med 'jug mdzad nyer bdun gyi/ /'phrin las mtshungs pa med la ྾ ྾ mo/ /bya dkas mi ngal byang chub mdzadag mdzad ches/ /bdag sogs srid par yongs dub yid can rnams/ /nyer bzhi'i skal bzang dga' ston mchog stsol ba'i/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med la ྾ ྾ ྾/ /yid can spyi dang lhag par dman la

246brtse/ /gdul bya spyi dang khyad par bdag sogs dgongs/ /gdul zhing spyi dang lhag par gangs ri'i khrod/ /skyong mdzad mtshungs pa med la ྾ mo ྾/ /ji tsam snyigs mar gyur pa de tsam gyis/ /thugs bskyed dar drag thub bstan mdzad smon khur/ /gcig tu 'khyer la zla med snying rje'i gter/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i sde la mo mo mo/ /ye shes rang snang gru 'dzin 'o/ brang cher/ /chos srid gser gyi 'kho ra los srid gsum la/ /dbang sgyur sa steng rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag /dpal ldan 'jigs bral bzang po ra gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi bka' drin kun gsal rin chen gyis/ /bkang ste bskal brgyar phul kyang gzhal min pas/ /lus longs dge tshogs kun bzang mabaspyacha/ /bka' bzhin bskrub pas khyed mnyes bgyid par gsol/ /rmad byung mtshan dpe'i snying po bzhin lag gi /lang tsho'i mdzes pa gzhom med rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog brtan chos bdun rang bzhin bskal brgya'i bar/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor bzhugs su gsol/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnga chen po'i sgra/ /tshul bzhin snyan pa'i tshangs dbyangs yan lag gsung / /sna tshogs khams bsam mos dbang rjes 'gro ba'i/ /zab rgyas theg chen chos 'khor bstodar du gsol/ /dmigs med snying rje'i rang bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /zab gsal dbye ra med mi 'gyur bde ba'i mchodag /rnam kun mchog ldan thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub

247bar du rjes su gzung du gsol/ /tshe rabs kun tu phyag na pad+mo yis/ /rjes bzung byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin te/ /don gnyis lhan grub 'phrin las mgon khyod dang / /mtshungs pa'i byin rlabs snying la 'jugre par mardzod/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i phyi mtha' ma rdzosas bar/ /de sring/ sa/nga 'dul sgyu 'phrul dra ba yis/ /mkha' mnyam ma rnams sgrol la masku na khyod dang / /mtshungs pa'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug par mdzod/ /gangs lhongs rgyal bstan dri med skyong ba'i mgon/ /gang gi thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings sprin chen las/ /mchog gi bkra shis chos char chen 11 yis/ /phyogs kun khyab pa'i dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig /ces rang cag kha ba ri pa rnams kyi lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo sdom brtson rgyal po'i rnam sdol 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs pa chen po mchodag la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa mtshan don gyi 'grel pa'i tshul du bkod pa 'di ni/ grub pa'i rigs su 'khrungs shing grol ba don du gnyer ba'i rnam dpyod yangs pa gtsang shud /khud pa bsod nams dbang rgyal nas bskul tshig gi me tog lhung ba dad pa'i thod du bcings te/brjod bya khyad 'phags 'di lta bur 'jug pa'i rjod byed ming tshig yig 'bru re re bzhin gyis bamo da nams dang ye shes kyi chodags rgya chen po gsog pa gor ma chag 'di ni bdag gis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par thob bo snyam

248pa'i mchog tu spro bas bteg ste/ kun rtog dge ba'i 'du byed nye bar bsten pas bsgrubs pa dag /re zhig yid kyi dbang por bsti ba las/ /yul du mngon pa'i go skabs ma 'tshal ba phyis rab rgyal shing stag chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin rang gi bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin dang chabs cig lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs nyid du smra ba po ni/ srid zhi'i rnam 'dren ma chog gi zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa'i skal bzang can/ sa mtha'i gzhis dgon chung ngu zhig gi bka' 'gyur bla ma'i mi nga tsam 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba blo bzang dbang phyug tu 'bod pa ste/ gsol 'debs 'di 'don pa po rnams kyi rgyud la 'phags macesag spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi snying la zhugs te/ dad pa dang / nges 'byung dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / lta ba rnam par dag pa mtha' dag pa khong du chud nas rtsol ba med pa'i myong ba rgyun mi chad du 'jug pa'i rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la nyi ma ltar gsal ba'i bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyi char chen po phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cang/ du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur ci/ //gso/la 'debs byin rlabs bkra shis char chen 'di//dge slong blo bzang rin chen dad gus kyis//par du bskrun dges bdag se gas 'brel thogs bcas//

249phyag na pad+mos rjes bzung byin rlabs nas//sgrib gnyis kun byang tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te//mngon sangs rgyas nas 'asprod rnams rnam mkhyen gyi//go 'phang mchog la bde blag 'god nus pa'i//'phrin las nam mkha' srid du rgyas gyur cig / //

0bcu pa/༄༄//7gongasalhami'isdoma'aṭ+wāṃn 7sngibasatram̐ gon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyan ga gas chan pa bcu bzhi pa mchog gi gser zhal dgyes ston gyi gsol mchog rkusanga'adabs phyagaX las rnam par rgyal ba' oṃ shaṃgs snyan ༷sa rjo rjo ༷zhuX ༷//ོ༵ṭ+wā+oṃ tan hūṃnasta rdzo/gaṭaṃ ༵/dīsngi da/nga/ ༵na~X ṭ+wāṃri ṭ+wāṃje ṭ+wāṃsdo tram̐rmi/ rtso/༵ bye sbyaṭ+wāṃ gas/ /rab dgyas sashi pa' tram̐r ༷ga //gsastsal/ne/phun gas phyagasalas rnam rgyalabakro ༷jekya/ /dag maX sagragaso pa' bye/ charas gsum du//snyano paṭ+wāṃ 'ja lo 'amugs bral garings raXne mgano//ḍi gsum dbang sgyur mchag sa 'gra 'ad skyangs//nyar bzha' mchag brnyas rgyal

251kun snying rje'i gter/ /srid la rjes chags srid zhi'i rnam 'dren rje/ /gang 'dul rab 'byams sgyu 'phrul dru ba'i sprin/ /spro mkhas phyag na pablo ra gus phyag 'tshal/ /'jam dpa' dpa' bo'i ngag la dbang sgyur zhing / /blo bzang ye shes rgyal bstanaci'adzin pa la/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab srid gsum dbang sgyur dgon/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod ring nas rin chen byang chub thugs/ /goms pa phul byung stobs bcu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /srid par dub pa'i 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum mgon zhabs la gasdudal ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas bye ba 'bum phrag grangs med dang / /rab mnyam gang mtshan gcig chodag spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba rgya mchorware dkyil 'khor 'khor 'esare mgon/ /sna tshogs gar gyis rol la gsol ba 'debs/ /bye ba phrag brgyar bcu gnyis mdzad ldan gyi/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren stodang gi bstan pa yang / /gang gi ye shes sgyu ma rnam 'phrul ba'i/ /legs mdzad mtshungs pa med la gasdudal ba 'debs/ /khyad par rab dkar ke la sha ri'i ljongs/ /thub bstan mdo sngags snang ba dkar po'i mdzod/ /spel la zla bral bu ram shing pa'i ༷༅nga / /gsal mdzad mtshungs pa med la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags yul dam chos bsam 'phel dbang gi nor/ /bsil ljongs gser ldan lto bar gtams mdzad pa'i/ /lo paṇa rgyal blon mkhas grub grangs med

252kyi/ /rnam rol ngo mtshar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /gcig dang du ma las 'das ye shes sku/ /rim dang cig car sna dzadags rnam bkod brgyas/ /gangs ljongs sgrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad srol/ /spel mdzad rgyal bstan bdag por gasdudal ba 'debs/ /lhag par rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa nas/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i bar/ /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba rim byon gyis/ /'jam dbyangs ring lugs spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzam bu'i dbyangs kyis rab bsngags gling chen po'i/ /dran dbang bye ba'i gtsug tor nor bu'i khrir/ /brjid chags zhabs skyes 'kho ra lo legs bkod pa'i/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyig 'dzin dum bu drug ldan gling gi khyon/ /dbang sgyur sgyu skar can gyi dkyil 'khor ches/ /rab rmongs kla klo'i mun nag mthar bsrings pa'i/ /khams gsum 'kho ra los sgyur la gso/la ba 'debs/ /snying rje'i chu gter rab rgyas 'phrin las rlabs/ /dus kyi mthar yang yol med rnam grol zhing / /rgyal ba'i chos tshul rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skye rgu'i rnam 'dren mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub pa'i zla ba chos dbyings chu lha'i mkhar/ /gzhol yang gang mdzad 'od brgya'i sgyu 'phrul brgyas/ /thub bstan snang bas 'dzam gling nyin mor mdzad/ /gangs ljongs nyi ma'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzam gling chos srid zhi bde'i snang bar

253bkod/ /'phags yul yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan nyin ltar gsal/ /gangs ljongs bstan srid rang dbang gtsang mar gsos/ /slar dar bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /che rgu'i do ker nor bu'i lan tshar bsnyil/ /phas rgol mi bsrun smra ngan rmeg med bcom/ /nag dre gas kla klo'i lta ngan mthar mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i lung zin dpal ldan gangs ri'i khrod/ /ngo mtshar mdzad brgyas skyong la mi g.yel bar/ /dgyes 'dzum mtshan dpe'i gser zhal myur lton pa'i/ /ston 'khor dga' lton skal bzang mdzad du gsol/ /chos tshigs yul dbus bsil ljongs chodas kyi zhing / /gru 'dzin rgyal ba dgyes pa'i gar+ghoṃ lar/ /'jigs bral chos kyi khri 'phang chos 'khor gyis/ /skyodang bzhin bskal ba rgya mtshor zhabs brtan gsol/ /khams kyi rjes 'gro'i 'ahro la tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /legs 'doms chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong lung / /zag med zhi ba gya nom bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /zab rgyas dam pa'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /sa gsum gser gyi yon brgya spungs pas kyang / /cha tsam 'tshal min dam chos mdo sngags mdzod/ /stsal ba'i bka' drin gzhal phyir chos spyod bcur/ /bka' bzhin skrub pa'i mnyes mchod 'bul bar bgyi/ /bdag sogs 'di nas tshe rabs phreng ba kun/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mos rjes bzung ste/ /tshogs gnyis sa

254lam yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /snga na gnyis lhun grub 'gro ba'i 'dren par shog /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub par lha ga /ces rang cag kha ba can gyi lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo sdom brtson rgyal po'i rnam rol/ sa steng rgyal bstan sku ngas cadags kyi bdag po/ 7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog gis bod ljongs 'dzam gling dang bcas pa chos srid zhi bdes skyong ba'i thugs rje dang bka' drin/ gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan dang 'phrin las rlabs po che'i stodabs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po/ bstan pa slar dar gyi srol 'byed shing rte chen po ngo mtshar mtshungs pa med pa'i tshul la mchog tu bsngags pa'i shis tshig/mtshan dpe'i gser zhal dgyes ston gyi gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba zhig skal bzang dga' ston gyi rten 'brel slad du 'bri dgos zhes/ gtsang pa snam dga' gdong dgon 'bras sprungs slo gsal gling gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rig 'dzin bstan pa'i slob ma rab 'byams smra ba dpal ldan rgya mtsho lags nas gsung nan chen po'i ngor/ srid zhi'i rnam 'dren mchog gi zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa'i skal bzang can/ yul byang 'brog tu skyes pa'i dge slong chos smra ba blo bzang dbang phyug tu 'bod pasri dad gus dang ba chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ rab rgyal sa lug chu stod zla ba'i ya ra tshes bzhi'i nyin/ mnyam rme da jo bo chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sne thang du sbyar ba bkra shis dang dge mtshan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyur grur cig/ maṅgawaṃ/
